The course then covers online transactions and compares the features  advantages and disadvantages of various available online payment systems.Finally  we examine e-commerce analytics to highlight the importance of tracking all data related to your website’s traffic. We define an ‘e-commerce analytics environment’ and establish why management is important in e-commerce. In today’s digital world  the demand for those skilled in e-commerce management will grow as online business expands. Aspiring entrepreneurs and businesspeople can benefit from this course as they hone their ability to manage online commerce.

product_name: Basics of Architectural Construction Drawing and Reading
description: When you build something  you need detailed drawings to show you how everything should fit together. Without architectural knowledge  you may feel perplexed the first time you open a building plan. We've created a tutorial for deciphering architectural drawings. Imagine if you could understand the architect's ideas. Maybe you could start thinking like a civil engineer or even be in a builder's shoes when comprehending the roofs  floors  and other facilities' designs. Anyone who takes this class will learn the basics of reading construction drawings.Understanding blueprints is vital to moving up in the construction industry. This knowledge will make you more valuable and give you access to new opportunities. This course makes this path easier by dividing the learning process into two modules. The first teaches you how to read house plans  and the second instructs you about architecture so you can understand planning ideas  measurements  and building designs.You'll learn to interpret building designs at the end of these lectures  and grasp key structural elements using practical examples. You'll also be able to recognise well-designed columns. Study the foundations  like the plinth  beam shuttering  and slab reinforcements. By enrolling in and completing this course  you will gain knowledge with helpful software tools for calculations and analytics like Excel and ETABS. Plans are the backbone of the construction company. Do not miss the chance to gather knowledge that might gain you a promotion. Learn the plans  build your future  or even design your own house. The material also unpacks Vastu shastra  a traditional Indian system of architecture that has guidelines on spatial geometry  layout  space arrangement and more.  Enrol now!

product_name: Basics of Furniture Restoration and Design
description: Has your old furniture lost its charm because of fractures and stains? Learn everything about furniture restoration  from creating a suitable workspace to selecting the right piece of furniture and planning the restoration process to finishing the project. We describe how wood reacts to certain conditions and identify the types of wood used in manufacturing. We lay out the steps involved in sanding and stripping the wood and explain how to remove old finishing before applying a new one. We demonstrate how to repair damage such as gouges  dents  loose screws and more.The course then outlines how to stain  varnish  wax and perform other finishing processes. We explore upholstery techniques and show you how to remove old upholstery and find the right material to replace it. We examine the tools required to work with leather as you prepare furniture for reupholstery. The course traces the differences between restoration  repairing and conservation of furniture before breaking down the process of restoring antique furniture  using a Marquetry table as an example.Finally  we study the various techniques for restoring metals  glass  plastic and ceramic. We break down the safety precautions designed to minimise the risks associated with furniture restoration  such as fire hazards  electrical shock  high-intensity noise and others. This course has no prerequisites and opens doors to many career opportunities like furniture designer and upholstery service provider. Sign up to learn how to bring out the hidden beauty of old furniture as vintage meets modern via your newfound skills.

product_name: Design  Deliver  and Administer Web Applications using LAMP
description: LAMP Stack (short for Linux  Apache  MySQL  PHP/Perl/Python) is the best framework for facilitating fast web development. Do you want to be able to scale without experiencing downtime and deal with unexpected traffic peaks? This course better equips you to handle sudden spikes in website traffic and provide customers with stable online services. You will cover installing and setting up files such as vagrant and load balancer. Learn about the lamp stack architecture design to create websites and applications that are unique to you.Next  you will learn the different types of scaling to set a system to handle the increase in demand without impacting the performance of an application. Learn how to connect the web server to applications and configure high availability for IP addresses. Discover the steps of creating high availability storage using GlusterFS and the key considerations in using the Cloud. Uncover the process of setting up the Percona XtraDB Cluster and how to use it for high availability.After completing this course  you will deploy highly available web services and withstand single points of failure. Learn how to improve the infrastructure to accommodate an increasing number of users to the site. This course is suitable for anyone who would like to build a career as a web developer or start creating a sound design to repair any flaws quickly and effectively. Start learning LAMP Stack programming today!

This course lays out each stage of the sewing process in depth. It starts with an introduction to the various parts of a sewing machine as we examine its accessories and features. Knowing the different types of sewing machines gives you an extra edge and we compare various models available on the market.We then describe the various tools needed for the sewing process  starting with hand-stitching. Any aspiring sewing enthusiast requires a thorough understanding of thread functions and we lay out the different types of threads. To help you become an expert at sewing and embroidery  we explore the fundamental factors of fabrics and various stitches.The course then covers employing patterns  pattern envelopes and their usage. We outline the cutting and marking process and its role as part of your final preparations before sewing. You will then learn how to sew seams  hand stitches and hems. Finally  we explain how to maintain a sewing machine to keep it working properly. Sewing is an ancient skill that never goes out of style and changes with shifts in new technology. So sign up to unleash your creative skills and become your own tailor.

product_name: Learn English: Movies and Future Perfect Continuous Tense
description: Watching movies at home or in the cinema is a popular leisure activity  and fans love discussing their favorite films  how they were made  and who starred in them. We have therefore designed this course to teach you basic vocabulary related to movies and filmmaking. This English course helps you master the language used to converse about your favorite movies  characters  and actors.We cover two grammar topics. First  we review the future perfect tense and compare it to the future simple tense to help you understand when it is more appropriate to use each. We introduce you to the future perfect continuous tense and demonstrate how to use it to form statements and questions. The second grammar topic covers discussions about plans  intentions  and predictions. We show you how to use 'will' and 'going to' when discussing the future. The course also covers their use as part of noun clauses. We examine 'would' in noun clauses to discuss once-laid plans that have since changed or did not happen.You will then integrate your new grammar and vocabulary skills by practicing reading  listening  and writing using what you have learned about the movies  filmmaking  the future perfect  the future perfect continuous  and 'will' and 'going to.' Continue to progress as an English student by ensuring that you take the time to practice. To help you further your skills  we have included some writing tips and exercises in our 'Resources' section. Sign up today and gain confidence when discussing movies with your friends.

The world of taxation may be confusing for business owners  accountants and anybody involved in the financial aspects of running a company. Take this course to learn how to thrive in the world of value-added tax (VAT) and master the related monetary computations. This VAT course will teach you everything you need to know to confidently calculate taxes for your business. We lay out the principles required to fully comprehend the essential concepts associated with value-added taxation  including its specific features in the United Kingdom.This VAT training has twelve information-packed classes that explain how to incorporate it into your business profits. We go through the fundamentals of VAT operations and examine the essential terminology and computations to provide you with a thorough explanation of the relevant regulations even if you have only a basic understanding of accounting and finance. The course demonstrates how to identify taxable individuals and functions  provide accurate invoices and records and digitise taxation procedures  among other practices. If you want to work in accounting or business  this is the course for you as VAT training offers an ideal opportunity to learn financial management abilities. This course has no prerequisites and forms a foundation for further study in accountancy  finance and their related fields. You can work at your own pace and exercises provide an opportunity to practise your new skills with practical examples. Sign up to learn how VAT works in the UK in order to comply with the law and take advantage of its financial aspects to save you and your business money.

product_name: Beginner Chemistry: Redox Reactions  Equilibrium & Rates of Reaction
description: This course begins with an overview of the five types of chemical reactions: combination  decomposition  single-displacement  double-displacement and combustion. We describe each of these reactions in detail to explain how their reactants combine to form one new compound or degrade into more substances. We then cover oxidation numbers and their role in a chemical reaction as atoms or ions lose or gain electrons and are labelled as ‘oxidised’ or ‘reduced’ respectively. The course outlines how these oxidation rules apply to metal and non-metal compounds. Our next topic discusses redox reactions  which involve the exchange of electrons between reactants. We show you how to name inorganic compounds by replacing the suffix ‘ine’ with ‘ide’.We then move on to chemical equilibrium and the factors that impact it. We study reversible reactions  which involve reactants and products that are interchangeable  before laying out the distinctive features of an equilibrium reaction under constant conditions. The course defines equilibrium expression’ and traces the connection between the equilibrium constant and temperature  pressure  concentration and catalysts. We compare weak and strong acids and bases and outline their dissociation processes. This is followed by an analysis of pH and the scale used to measure the acidity of a solution.The course covers reaction kinetics  which is the study of the rate of a chemical reaction and the variables that affect it. We explain how the quantity of reactants or products changes over time and how that affects the rate of reaction. We also examine collision theory  which explains how reaction conditions like energy and orientation influence the rate of the reaction. Finally  we demonstrate the acceleration of a chemical reaction by raising the temperature  concentration and surface area or using a catalyst. This basic chemistry course helps learners and students understand complex chemical concepts and breaks down complicated chemical processes into easy-to-understand steps. Sign up to understand chemical reactions and the equations used to calculate them.

product_name: Building Habits That Stick: Your Guide To Transforming Your Habits
description: Building a solid foundation of positive habits is important for your long-term growth so this self-improvement course explains how to identify and establish such habits using specific techniques. We show you how healthy habits can provide solutions to common problems. Although habits may seem like ‘small’ actions  they can contribute to your personal growth or decline over time. In order to build better habits or break old bad habits  we lay out the three steps in the habit-forming process: cue  routine and reward. Your newfound insight will help you to comprehend specific strategies designed to help you to optimise each step of this process.While providing a strong foundation in habit formation  this course leads you through a practical assessment designed to identify gaps in your habits and their impact on the pursuit of your goals. We explain how to compare habits that support your goals to those that don’t and how to develop routines that help you to achieve your goals. This process creates a ‘map’ to help you plan out the action steps you will take moving forward. This course also delves into the role of your mindset by demonstrating how to identify ‘limiting beliefs’. Limiting beliefs can hold you back or can even restrict your growth or potential. For example  limiting beliefs such as ‘I will never be successful’ can prevent you from building growth habits because of the connection between your thoughts and actions. Developing a positive mindset with empowering beliefs is essential as you embark on your habit transformation journey.The type of environment you build for yourself influences your habits because it contains the triggers that cause them to initiate. Your environment is not only made up of your physical space: it also includes your social background and your associations. Building an environment filled with triggers for positive habits increases your chances for success and makes it easier for you to make the right choices. Our habits represent the small actions that determine our direction so learning how to be conscious of our habit formation is very important in the pursuit of success. Sign up for this self help course to master the psychology behind habit formation and use a variety of strategies to build long-lasting healthy habits that drive you towards your goals.

product_name: Management and Treatment of Dual Diagnosis
description: Dual diagnosis was first identified in the 1980s in patients suffering severe mental illness and substance addiction at the same time. This combination remains a major concern for the healthcare industry and requires an integrated assessment and treatment approach in both mental health and substance misuse to overcome. This course covers treatments and management strategies for dual diagnosis. We begin with an overview of dual diagnosis and an explanation of how the brain works as we trace the connection between anxiety disorders and substance abuse.In order to provide effective dual diagnosis treatment  the two disorders must be integrated rather than treated separately. Such an approach to treatment combines psychotherapy  pharmacotherapy  detoxification  medication and group therapy. We explain the basics of contingency management treatment and outline various care models designed to ensure effective care management across drug misuse treatment services.The course lays out the policies governing dual diagnosis and identifies the penalties for drug misuse under various laws. We provide effective risk assessment and management techniques and our practical tips can help you deal with various issues you encounter in practice. Finally  we walk you through the stages of dual diagnosis treatment. We examine the medications and other types of treatment provided by substance abuse services. This psychology course is ideal for anyone interested in a career in mental health or counselling as we trace the links between substance abuse and mental disorders and explain how to treat both.

The foundation of the code used in this course is built on a sample project we create called ‘Social Bookmarks’. Practice is the only surefire method to become an expert at something. This web and app development course explains what hapi is  where it comes from and when to use it depending on the project you are working on. We outline the specifications you need to develop our social bookmarking application before establishing its environment.Developers have to make a lot of planning and architectural choices when building an application programming interface (API) and we guide you towards the right ones to help you build up your own API project. We then show you how to create endpoints using static data and how to test them using Postman. Nodemon is a utility that restarts your server automatically when it notices any changes to your source code. The course demonstrates how to use the node-inspector to debug any node application and the hapi tv plugin for request debugging.What distinguishes server-side caching from client-side caching? We spend some time comparing them and explain how to use ‘cookies’. The course then explores the development of real-time apps using nes and RethinkDB and third-party authentication implemented with bell. Finally  we explain how to secure your app and defend it from CSRF attacks with Crumb. We also show you how to deploy our app to the cloud using Heroku. This course provides the skills you need to build apps with hapi’s built-in support for input validation  caching  authentication and other key features for developing online applications and services. hapi is an easy-to-use configuration-essential framework. This course benefits coding beginners and veterans as hapiJS offers a dynamic and secure Javascript environment for web and app development.

‘Retail management’ deals with the day-to-day activities of a physical store. This course covers the principles and practices used to manage employees  customers  inventory and more. Retail management is constantly evolving as new technologies and techniques are constantly being developed to keep up with customers' changing needs. We identify different kinds of customers that come into a retail store and explain how to manage your team effectively to keep your business running smoothly. We begin by introducing you to some of the primary concepts involved in retail management and then move on to discuss how they are applied in real-world situations. We lay out retail strategies and compare centralised and decentralised buying before examining home shopping  the buying cycle and more. We then delve into pricing and the factors that influence it to help you manage supply chains in retail. When managing a retail store  it's important that you ensure your customers can find what they want when they want it. It's also important that you track sales and understand how your products are selling so that you can adjust your strategies accordingly. We explore consumer behaviour and demonstrate how to interpret it to deal with issues that may arise and appreciate its impact on the success or failure of a store. We study the concept of trends  their importance and how you can use them to successfully target customers and boost sales. The course teaches you how to talk to customers and manage customer relations. We establish the importance of a store location and explain how to choose a location  what sort of locations are best and issues that can arise from certain sites. We cover retail psychology and how to negotiate the right deal with suppliers.The presence of a security system in a store makes customers feel safe while making purchases. We discuss the various types of security used in different stores  the basics of security and what to do when things go wrong. Well-trained staff are key to ensuring customer satisfaction and we show you how to choose the right team and communicate with it. We explore the role of brand management and marketing in retail before examining various Consumer Rights Acts and health and safety regulations and practices. This course is designed for business owners  entrepreneurs and anyone interested in moving upward in the retail industry. A skilled retail manager can make the difference between a store failing or thriving and retail management can be a challenging but rewarding career that offers many opportunities for advancement. So sign up to learn how to run a retail store with your newfound knowledge of the many aspects of what goes into ensuring that your satisfied customers come back again and again.

product_name: A Comprehensive Guide to Creative Writing
description: Creative writing is the process-oriented form of writing that combines imagination and innovation to tell a story. The element of creativity sets your story apart from its counterparts in the same genre. Writing requires more than telling tales of fantastical settings thronged with unique creatures: it expresses your thoughts and feelings via a compelling and memorable story that engages your readers through character  language and plot. This course teaches you how to use your creativity to think a little outside the box and put a unique twist on things. Creative writing has many genres and subgenres and a set of established rules and practices that can help writers develop their own distinctive voices. We introduce you to these elements to help you get started with writing.The most challenging element of storytelling is often the plot  which is in turn driven by engaging characters. We show you how to create plots with suspense  sentiment and sensation and explain how to keep them moving through interesting  tangible settings. The course then explains how to build complex  vivid and unforgettable characters with compelling dialogue and action. We also examine the tools used by poets to write verse. We compare creative fiction and nonfiction writing and lay out the techniques used to create novels  short stories  dramas  screenplays and memoirs. Are you familiar with the term ‘writer’s block’? It is something that all writers face while struggling to create new work during a creative slowdown. We will demonstrate how to overcome writer's block and come up with original ideas when creativity seems elusive.The course then establishes the role of critical thinking to help you understand how technical writing differs from creative writing. We explain how to structure business proposals  letters  emails and meeting agendas. Writing is never complete unless published. The course walks you through the process of editing and evaluating text to meet publishing requirements and finally get your work out there. If you wish to explore your creativity and realise your dreams of becoming a writer  this course is for you. We provide the technical skills you need to turn your talent into published text using a unique writing process that breaks through writer’s block. Whether you have an idea for a novel or even a half-finished manuscript in a drawer  this course helps you to find your voice as a storyteller.

Concrete is a crucial material used in construction and its main ingredients are cement  fine aggregate  coarse aggregate and water. This course establishes the benefits of concrete that drive its widespread use in the construction industry. We outline the impact of poor concrete to explain why you need to test it before starting construction. This course goes through the various stages of the methods used to manufacture and test concrete.It is important that you learn how to classify concrete based on its binding materials  design and purpose. We examine the classification of aggregates based on their size  weight  nature of formation and shapes and provide different methods to test them  including the Elongation and Flakiness Index tests. We compare concrete’s compressive and tensile strength and explain how to use specific tools to perform non-destructive tests of hardened concrete.Finally  the course outlines how to ensure high-quality materials for building structures. It enhances knowledge and ability to test concrete and make the right decisions regarding construction materials. Using durable concrete that withstands all weather conditions will build your reputation with clients as an engineer. Whether you are a beginner or a professional contractor or engineer  this course will improve your professional skills.

Do you want to pursue a career in the field of mental health? If so  you have come to the right place. This psychology training course explains how to treat mental health disorders through counselling and psychotherapy. Both terms shall be defined as we trace the relationship between them. We go through the various types of treatment options associated with both.Are you curious about the mental health writings of renowned psychologists like Sigmund Freud or Carl Jung? We outline their key findings and principles and examine the contribution of many others in the field. We then study the evolution of treatment options from their origin to their current state and examine current trends in mental health care. The course breaks down the concept of psychodynamic (or psychoanalytic) psychotherapy  which probes the patient’s subconscious through ongoing conversation.The mental health industry has developed effective treatment options for a plethora of mental disorders. We match a wide range of mental health disorders to their psychotherapeutic treatment options while identifying key symptoms associated with each. The importance of mental health is gaining attention and openly talking about mental health is no longer considered the social taboo it once was. This psychology training course provides treatment options for a range of psychological disorders so sign up to learn how to use counselling and psychotherapy to guide patients towards improved mental health.

The cultivation  marketing and trade of flowers is collectively referred to as ‘floristry’  which includes the care and handling of flowers  floral design and arrangement  retailing  production  display and flower delivery. We begin this course by studying the anatomy of plants as such botanical knowledge is important to keeping flowers alive and healthy. In addition  we describe the dangerous effects of the plant hormone ethylene and demonstrate the benefits of understanding the specific requirements of each plant in your care.The course then explores the elements of floral designs  including the symbolism attached to the colour of flowers used in floral arrangements. We explain how your creativity can be harnessed to create beautiful arrangements and break down the components of wedding floristry. Finally  the course provides the tools you need to start your floristry shop and lays out the steps you should take to launch your floristry business successfully.This course covers the fundamental concepts of floristry. We provide practical techniques and insider tips you can use to confidently start your own business. From caring for living things to dealing with clients  this course explores the everyday life of a florist and suits anyone who wants to turn their eye for beauty and passion for flowers into a career.

Real estate agents earn their living by helping people to sell or buy property. If you like talking to people and thrive on making social contacts  this offers a rewarding and promising profession. This course begins by teaching you the basics of finding sellers and listing properties. We lay out the difference between valuation  evaluation and appraisal before highlighting the negotiation skills required by an estate agent.We then explain how to find buyers and list a property for sale or rent. A professional estate agent must be able to employ the letting process efficiently and we provide this skill. Today’s digital technology can drive the marketing of your products and services. Our lesson on digital marketing and ‘lead magnets’ adds conviction to your decisions as you learn to confidently sell yourself as well as real estate.The course goes through the regulations governing this profession before explaining how real estate agents establish their credibility through qualifications and their enforcement. The career path of an estate agent can lead upward by offering better earnings and leadership roles  both in sales or property management. Sign up to take advantage of this training course and acquire the skills you need to work as a real estate agent.

product_name: How to Manage a Poultry Farming Business
description: Do you want to find the latest information on the poultry farming industry? Are you keen on starting your own poultry farming venture? If so  this course is designed just for you. We provide all the relevant information needed to turn your business plans into reality. We begin by identifying the different types of chicken breeds that can be bred on a poultry farm before discussing their nutritional needs. We explain how to identify and prevent avian diseases that can affect your poultry.The course then lays out the basics of duck and turkey farming  starting with their housing and breeding requirements. We go over the incubation and brooding aspects of poultry farming to help you create the best conditions for it to prosper. Our overview of the housing and environmental aspects of poultry farming explains how to keep your flock healthy and safe. This includes pest control methods used to protect workers and birds on your farm.No business venture can be considered without understanding its economic aspect. We explore the marketing and accounting side of the poultry farming business and examine some relevant UK legislation. Poultry farming is a thriving industry in the UK and around the globe so enrol in this course to understand its dynamics and make your dreams real.

This health and safety course lays out the various safety hazards associated with asbestos and explains how to manage them to reduce the hazards posed by asbestos-related diseases. We describe the different types of asbestos  their hazardous properties and the most probable locations in which to find them. We also discuss the common results of asbestos exposure and define its exposure limits established by various international organisations.Our course outlines the most common asbestos-related diseases and goes over various control measures that can be implemented to reduce the risk of exposure. We discuss the contributing factors that fuel asbestos-related health risks and identify which professions are at greater risk of experiencing them. We explain how licensed asbestos professionals remove the substance from buildings. The course concludes with a detailed step-by-step demonstration of the waste management steps used to reduce the health and safety risks posed by asbestos. This course suits anyone likely to be exposed to asbestos at home or work. It also explains how to comply with specific regulatory requirements  which benefits health and safety officers or managers who must deliver training to employees. It also suits anyone who intends to take advanced asbestos courses to carry out any work with this occurring mineral. Sign up to learn how to manage this deadly material and reduce the health and safety risks it poses.

Smart meters allow households to monitor their domestic energy usage and save money. As more energy companies offer smart meters to their customers' homes  more front-line advice personnel will require appropriate knowledge about the capabilities and advantages of smart meters. This course lays out the installation procedure and the regulations governing smart meters and their deployment. We begin by establishing the potential and advantages of smart power grid technologies. The course then describes the different aspects of designing smart metering systems and examines their features and auxiliary components. We explain the installation process of various smart meters  including the SMETS  50kA-3  63A-1  63A-3 and 65A-3 models.The next section explores the Smart Meter Installation Code of Practice and lays out the installer's role and responsibilities during pre-installation  installation and post-installation visits. We then highlight how a smart meter’s cost/benefit analysis differs for household and non-domestic uses. Finally  we explore the policy guidelines and the various Acts related to smart meters in the UK. Sign up to take advantage of the government’s Green agenda and be a part of the national effort to modernise the UK’s energy grid and reduce both greenhouse emissions and domestic energy costs.

Childbirth can be a blissful and cherished moment while also being overwhelming and unsettling as it brings discomforting physical changes. These can include contractions  back pain  swollen breasts  the frequent need to urinate and more. Pregnant women/persons require care  support and medical attention to endure such a difficult and daunting time. Due to its rough periods  pregnancy may demand the skills and experience of a birth doula. A birth doula is a childbirth professional who provides informational  emotional and physical support before and after labour. This course explains the roles and responsibilities of a birth doula and why a pregnant woman/person might need them.Understanding how a woman/person's body functions during pregnancy are crucial for both a birth doula and an expectant parent. We describe the anatomy of females' sexual and reproductive parts and explain infertility  menopause  how to fall pregnant  how babies grow and the progressive changes that occur in a body during pregnancy. Workplace stress can be harmful to a foetus  depending on the gestation age of its parent  and we demonstrate how to determine when a pregnant woman/person should take a break from work and focus on their pregnancy. As a birth doula  paying attention to a pregnant woman's/person's diet is critical because anything they eat can affect the foetus. Some therapies can assist a person in getting through the phases of pregnancy. We provide dietary information concerning pregnancy  complementary therapies  and exercises to help a prospective parent.We then explore pregnancy symptoms and how to manage them before describing various clinical tests performed on pregnant women/persons. You will learn how newborn babies are screened and cared for. The course then examines the postpartum period and outlines how a woman/person recuperates after labour  how newborn babies are screened and more. It is critical for couples to plan out their desired number of children and the spacing and timing of their births. Such family planning can prevent unplanned pregnancies and the health and financial risks they create. We provide the nitty gritty of family planning and explain how to communicate effectively before going through the birth doula's code of ethics. This course has no prerequisites and provides the training required to become a professional doula  a career path that is growing in importance and popularity as many pregnant women/persons require their assistance to get through the difficult stages of pregnancy and labour. Sign up to acquire the birth coaching skills you need to work as a birth companion.

product_name: A Comprehensive Guide to Construction Safety
description: Ensuring the safety and wellbeing of workers is a legal and ethical requirement of every organisation and business. This course introduces you to the health and safety measures that should be implemented to reduce work-related accidents in the construction industry. We lay out each step taken to carry out a risk assessment to identify and evaluate workplace hazards before the start of construction work. Construction covers a wide array of activities of different kinds  each prone to serious and even fatal injuries to workers. It is therefore important to know the procedures to follow in order to report incidents in a workplace. We outline how to report accidents in the workplace and examine the legal requirements for reporting such incidents.Working at heights and in confined spaces also poses serious risks to workers  including falls and exposure to toxic fumes. This course describes the necessary precautions that should be taken before anyone works in such environments in order to minimise the risk of accidents. We then discuss injuries caused by manual and mechanical handling and the safety precautions used to prevent them. Chemicals can exist in a variety of states and be solid  liquid  gas or plasma. During construction  workers may be exposed to hazardous chemicals such as carbon monoxide  asbestos  lead  silica and spray paints. They require proper protection to avoid risks to their health. We go over chemical classifications  the health risks these substances pose and the safety precautions to take. We then compare electrical and fire hazards on a construction site and their safety measures you should put in place to protect workers. Finally  we lay out the UK legislation governing health and safety construction to help you comply with regulations designed to prevent workplace accidents.We designed this course for people who work or intend to work in the construction industry. It is also useful for those who want to pursue a career in the field of health and safety or want to build their knowledge base in the field. This is a basic level course and requires no prerequisite knowledge or experience to join. The instructor explains the processes used to protect health and safety in construction  from hazard identification to implementing appropriate control measures. Every construction organisation requires a dedicated health and safety department to ensure the safety of workers and equipment. The application of occupational health and safety management is vast in the construction industry and offers numerous rewarding career opportunities to people with the right knowledge and expertise in the UK and elsewhere. Join the course to take advantage of such opportunities and master the skills required to legally complete construction jobs.

product_name: Preschool Education: The Reggio Emilia Approach
description: This teacher training course provides a brief overview of the Reggio Emilia approach to preschool education. We discuss the factors that have a positive effect on young children's development and explain how early childhood education contributes to their success. We then examine the key factors that define this teaching model in detail. The course explains the characteristics of the contemporary educational doctrine known as ‘constructivism’  which argues that children play an active role in their own education instead of passively absorbing it.The course then explains how to understand the facial language of children  which can convey several different and profound meanings. We examine the role of the preschool environment and discuss how to integrate it into the Reggio Emilia educational philosophy. We then define ‘pedagogical documentation’ and outline why keeping comprehensive records of classroom interactions is important. This includes its role in cultivating reflective thinking in children.The Reggio Emilia approach emphasises the critical notion of creativity and its role in preschool education. We discuss how creativity develops in early childhood and examine its defining characteristics before comparing the Montessori  Waldorf and Reggio Emilia teaching models and weighing their respective advantages and disadvantages. This course is ideal for parents  preschool teachers or child psychologists who want to develop their knowledge about this innovative approach to preschool education. The Reggio Emilia model has only been around since World War Two but it has already changed the way we understand childhood development and the role of preschool in guiding it.

The demand for personal financial advisors is expected to grow faster than most national averages over the next few years. This career path also offers the advantages of almost unlimited earning potential and a flexible work schedule. This finance course was developed for anyone interested in a career that will not be threatened by new information technology and developments in artificial intelligence. We begin with an overview of a financial advisor’s roles and responsibilities as we lay out their essential skills.The course goes through the financial planning process and provides insider tips to help you and your clients identify and avoid many types of financial risk. We discuss various investment profiles to guide your financial decisions. Financial planning is a critical role and responsibility and represents the long-term method of prudently managing resources to achieve one’s goals  which requires careful calculation and knowledge of the world of finance. We also explain how to resolve marital problems using financial settlement.We designed the course to provide aspiring financial advisors with the most up-to-date skills and knowledge required to excel in this role. Acquiring the best advisor mindset and learning financial concepts allows you to understand your client’s financial needs and provide them with the best financial advice. Whether it’s for yourself  your clients or your business  this course provides the financial planning skills you need to control your financial future and kickstart a lucrative career as a financial advisor.

A financial controller is a person in charge of overall accounting and record-keeping for an organization  including managing related staff. They keep track of every expense incurred  records that serve as the fundamental framework of every business and that are essential components of all corporate activity. Financial control is the heartbeat of every organization and inaccurate bookkeeping would create problems when completing tax returns. Therefore  this course has been developed to go over the key duties that the financial controller plays in an organization.At the beginning  financial control and financial controllers are defined. Then  we will go through how financial control is implemented  the importance of financial controllers  and their main duties. To control an organization’s financial activities  a financial controller must efficiently meet their responsibilities otherwise the organization will not be able to meet its financial obligations. Additionally  the skills a successful financial controller needs to have will be covered. The use of these abilities in business-related financial transactions - such as financial analysis  ratio analysis  budgetary control  strategic management decisions and financial audits - will also be covered in detail.This course is suitable for both experienced and aspiring financial controllers. By the end  you will have a thorough understanding of financial control and awareness of the main duties and expertise required of financial controllers. This could place you as the guardian of your organization’s financial activities. So  what are you waiting for? Enrol in this course to get started now!

product_name: Safe Handling and Administration of Medication
description: Allopathic (or ‘mainstream’) medicine treats diseases with drugs that could be potentially harmful or ineffective if not properly administered. It is essential that the health industry standardises the safe handling and administration of medication. This free medical health and safety course provides the knowledge required to safely administer drugs. We discuss the role of the government in establishing and maintaining the laws and policies that ensure that effective medicines are administered properly.The course then traces the link between medical management and professional communication  which is essential to ensure that all healthcare professionals caring for a patient share the same information and that any potential problems associated with their care are resolved. Encouraging patients to take an active role in maintaining medication safety is one approach used to reduce incidents of medication error. Patient involvement can improve the health and quality of life of those in your care and lowers the risk of unintended harm.We discuss the details of prescription medicine and examine the safe handling of hazardous drugs (HDs). We examine the record-keeping and audit processes  which are important in ensuring that procedures  care plans and medication management principles operate in accordance with policy. Finally  we investigate the impact of the Covid-19 pandemic on the safe use of medication. This course provides you with technical skills that are critical for patients' safety. Sign up for this patient safety course to learn how to safely prescribe and administer medical drugs without risking the health and wellbeing of those in your care.

Construction projects are never simple and require careful planning to establish their overall direction. A project plan is a collection of documents that can evolve throughout a project. To plan any project successfully  you must first understand the fundamental concept of planning. This project management course lays out the crucial steps of the process of the project planning and scheduling process. We begin with a definition of ‘planning’ and an examination of the requirements of the planning process.The course then explains how to determine the scope and nature of construction projects and emphasises the importance of project scheduling. Once established and agreed upon  the project schedule is referred to as the ‘baseline schedule’. We outline how to prepare and complete a baseline schedule for substructure and superstructure construction works.We go through a number of tools designed to monitor progress on projects  starting with the ‘Bill Of Quantities’ (BoQ) used to measure the monthly quantities of material required to complete construction. We then explain how to calculate the monthly cost rate and prepare an invoice. The course covers the process of estimating bulk material quantities for specific activities as calculating the correct coefficients for PCC  concrete  plastering and flooring works is critical. Our final sections address labour and lay out the procedures for determining how many workers are required for each phase of the construction project. Sign up to learn how to apply project planning and management principles to the field of construction.

Do you struggle to stay motivated or often find yourself overwhelmed by challenges and obstacles? This self help course explores the principles of personal development to help you make healthy changes. We begin with analysis of the techniques used to stay motivated  refreshed and on top of your game. We examine factors like sleep patterns  nutrition and mental habits that can boost or sap your motivation. The course then moves on to anger management. Do even minor issues make you angry? If so  these effective anger management methods that have been developed over the years can help you overcome the challenge of unwanted emotions. We discuss various theories and studies conducted by psychologists to provide you with the most reliable tools for channelling anger into healthier emotions and converting it into a useful resource.Do you find it difficult to unleash and control your creativity? We lay out methods used to harness your intellect and emotions to find the most innovative ways to solve problems. We explain how to overcome various creative obstacles and how to drive innovation and make decisions by thinking ‘outside the box’. Personal development is an integral part of everyone’s evolution. Confidence  drive and self-control are skills like any other and this self-improvement course provides models  techniques and tools to guide you towards your best self.

Good business etiquette fosters a professional  respectful environment that enhances communication and boosts productivity. This course establishes the importance of ethics and good manners in business. We then explain how to properly bill your company for expenses and examine the etiquette of using a phone. We answer questions like ‘how can I develop a confident handshake’ and ‘what are some rules of good manners?’.The course then explores dining etiquette  including specific table manners like those concerning the holding of cutlery. We explain how your creativity can be politely harnessed to make positive gestures. Finally  we provide the tools you need to become familiar with global business etiquette and cross-cultural communication. We delve into important workplace topics like sexual harassment and office romance to help you avoid ethical pitfalls and breakdowns of courtesy.This course lays out the rules and conventions of corporate etiquette to help you develop the social skills required to navigate the world of business. We provide practical techniques and insider tips you can use to confidently impress your peers. From talking one to colleagues one-on-one to dealing with clients  this course explores the everyday experience of using corporate social skills to avoid conflict and succeed in the office.

This child psychology course covers the significant role of self-regulation in early childhood development. We discuss how these skills can help children to behave thoughtfully and purposefully and explain how children learn to exhibit self-regulated behaviors. We then trace the links between self-regulation and the development of self-confidence  problem-solving skills and self-esteem. The course then delves into the three dimensions of self-regulation: attention  emotion and behavior. This includes an examination of how a child learns to delay gratification to increase their chances of success.The course then explains how preschool education helps develop these skills. We break down the sequence of steps involved in acquiring self-regulation in early childhood and trace the role of preschools in aiding this important process. We show you how parents can create an environment that is conducive to learning for their children and identify the most significant factors they should consider when trying to manage childhood behavior. The course then discusses Lev Vygotsky's cultural-historical approach to self-regulation and his emphasis on supporting self-regulation skills in early childhood.We explore the relationship between sociodramatic play involving children acting and self-regulation in early childhood. We provide various sociodramatic games and symbolic plays designed to encourage children to take responsibility for their actions. Are you wondering how self-regulation skills are assessed in the preschool period? The course covers the different assessment methods and observation tools that are used to assess self-regulation skills. We also demonstrate how to evaluate the self-regulation abilities of children based on favorable environmental conditions. This course is ideal for parents  preschool teachers and child psychologists who want to improve their childhood development skills. Teaching children how to take control of their actions has lifelong benefits as the foundations for ethical living are laid in early childhood so sign up to learn how to guide children towards the best versions of themselves.

Workers are considered ‘productive’ when they efficiently complete their tasks and reach their organisational goals on time. Inefficient organisational structures and office problems can compromise such productivity and slow down processes. This management training course identifies the factors that affect office efficiency and explains how to improve your team’s capabilities.We show you how to set up a favourable workspace and demonstrate the importance of effective communication in the workplace. The management skills provided in this course are always in demand across various industries and organisational levels. Sign up to add value to your professional expertise and enrich your professional portfolio.

product_name: Cyber security: Understand Threats and Prevent Attacks
description: Efforts to prevent and manage cyber risks have become a major focus of organisations and governments across the world due to the rising number of daily cyber attacks. Organisations of all sizes must ensure their cyber security and protect their information systems and valuable intellectual property from attack. Implementing effective organisational security measures not only offers liability protection but also increases the organisation’s efficiency and productivity.Cyber security awareness is not only important to organisations and governments but also matters to individuals as it protects their personal and professional data as most people store vast amounts of sensitive data on their mobile phones and personal computers  including passwords  pictures of loved ones  credit card numbers and other financial data. Almost all of these devices are connected to the internet  meaning cybercriminals can potentially access this personal data and cause a range of problems.Such dangers explain why cyber security is a vital part of a well-ordered and secure digital environment. This cyber security training course lays out the basics of the field and explains how to classify threats and employ solutions and security measures to prevent each. This short and informative course is developed by Crafty E-Learning to help you to acquire specialist knowledge easily and our animated case study videos help you practise your newfound skills in real-life situations. Sign up to learn how to secure digital information and acquire a valuable new professional skill.

product_name: Customer Care Skills and Telephone Etiquette
description: ‘Customer service’ refers to the support and guidance that a company offers its clients. We begin this course by establishing the importance of developing long-term relationships with customers. We then explain the importance of good customer service to these relationships and how to develop communication skills for dealing with customers. We answer questions like ‘why should you provide great customer service?’ and ‘what are some key elements of a proactive customer relations management cycle?’.The course then demonstrates how to learn the service model used to build good relations with customers and the ‘defusing’ techniques that calm angry customers. We explore different strategies to maintain a good rapport with customers  including the use of good telephone etiquette. We outline some tips for handling angry customers and explore the art of listening and silence. These enhanced communication skills are fundamental to customer relations management (CRM) and promote good customer service.This course offers an opportunity to master customer care skills and learn telephone etiquette. We provide practical ideas and techniques you can confidently use in your daily life. We lay out the principles and techniques relevant to business customer care and explain how to implement them in the workplace. Sign up for this customer service training course to learn how to employ proper telephone etiquette to gain an edge in the field of customer relations and keep clients satisfied and calm.

product_name: How to Become a Family Support Worker
description: This social work training course explores the many roles of family support workers in the United Kingdom. It starts by defining ‘family support’ and outlining the duties and responsibilities of a family support worker. We go through a family support’s daily activities and required qualities before explaining how to become one. We then go through the numerous pieces of legislation  policies and guides available to family support workers. This includes an analysis of developments and changes to several child protection regulations affecting family workers  guardians and those who work with children and families.The course then explains how to solve common family conflicts. We examine the risk factors and the impact of parental mental health problems and substance and domestic abuse on children's emotional wellbeing and development. We show you how such issues affect parenting and provide ways to help them. The course studies the effect of separation  divorce and failures of parental responsibility on families to train you to be able to handle such sensitive topics and support children in these situations.We then define ‘safeguarding’ and establish why it is crucial for children’s development. The course demonstrates how to conduct a high-quality risk assessment of domestic situations. Our final section explains how to establish a positive relationship with families and why doing so is important for a family support worker. If you care about other people and want to use your social work skills to support families  this course is for you! product_name: Choosing a Career Based on Passion
description: Have you ever wondered what career is right for you? This job search course explains how to choose the right profession that complements your personal passions and talents. We lay out the factors to consider when choosing a career and provide tools you can use to identify your interests and reach your full potential. We lay out methods such as ‘learning styles’  ‘deliberate practice’ and ‘self-monitoring’ for improving your performance. We go over the guidelines used to make sure you are prepared for interviews and present yourself professionally. We describe the dangers you will encounter while searching for potential employers and identify pitfalls to avoid. We also explain how to choose the best references and testimonials. Decision-making is a skill like any other and can be learned. The decisions you make regarding your career are likely to impact your life and wellbeing so it’s worth learning how to make sure they are the right ones. This job search course gives you the confidence required to pursue your passions and find work that brings out your best. Sign up to find ways to monetise your skills and interests and be inspired!

product_name: OSHA Fundamentals - Ladder Safety & Prevention of Injuries
description: Today’s proper inspection rules and implementation of safety regulations and standards has led to a worldwide decrease in occupation-related injuries and deaths. However  numerous risks still exist and it is crucial that health and safety managers recognize and understand them to protect workers and equipment from harm.This course identifies the various regulatory agencies and organizations responsible for developing occupational safety standards and regulations and focuses on the U.S. federal agency Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA. OSHA’s purpose is to protect workers and employees from various occupational hazards and this course lays out its basics. We explain how OSHA works and how you can legally implement its rules to protect workplace health and safety. This training enables you to comply with important regulations applicable to your specific professional setting.Apart from explaining OSHA's framework  this course also explains some of the most important OSHA occupational safety requirements for preventing occupational injuries caused by slips  trips and falls off ladders. We define important terms related to these hazards and compare them to each other. We also provide some important statistics to help you understand the gravity of these hazards. Each topic includes assessment questions to help you test and revise your newfound knowledge. This OSHA course provides the compliance training you need to meet your legal obligations as manager and protect the health and safety of those around you in the workplace.

product_name: ISO 14005 - Fundamentals of EMS Phased Implementation for SMEs
description: Enterprises and business organizations are some of the top contributors to global carbon emissions. Some primary reasons for this phenomenon are mismanagement  improper implementation of environmental ethics  and lack of a functioning environmental management system (EMS). However  many organizations are willing to modify their practices to become more eco-friendly. In this regard  the International Organization for Standardization has developed a family of standards known as ISO 14000.The ISO 14000 comprises three standards that help organizations develop and manage a functioning EMS. However  the main focus of this course is the ISO 14005 standard  which emphasizes helping organizations stay consistent in their EMS implementation  improvement  and continuous improvement. After enrolling in this course  students can get a detailed explanation of clauses 4  5  and 6.The course also explains the relationship between an effective EMS and the PDCA (plan-do-check-act) cycle. Moreover  the phased approach stated in the standard  along with its six stages  is also detailed in this course. Furthermore  enrollees will also be able to understand the relationship between the Maturity Matrix and Annexes A and B of ISO 14500. The course's developers have included various interesting graphics throughout the material to make the explanation of the standard easier for you to comprehend.

product_name: Fundamentals of Educational Psychology and Development
description: Educational psychology is about studying how people learn and retain information. It provides critical information to educators that helps them measure learning  create educational experiences and improve student understanding. This course introduces you to educational psychology and how it can be used to improve learning experiences. First  we explain the difference between psychology and educational psychology  and look at the contributions of prominent figures in educational psychology over time. You explore how learning takes place  what influences it and the common behavioural learning theories. After that  we teach you the general principles of development  the different stages of cognitive development including the attainment of key social skills  and the processes of social and moral development in children. Constructivism is a useful approach to learning that states that both social interactions and learner participation greatly influence the attainment of knowledge. Explore how knowledge is ‘constructed’ and the applications of constructivism in the process of learning.There are several specific learning difficulties and disorders that exist mainly due to neurological conditions. Learn about these in children and adults and how they impact their academic performance. Educational psychology plays an important role in the development of learning environments and the standards of teacher-student relationships. We’ll teach you about the key components required for elevating students’ motivation and ways to create a conducive learning environment. Explore an effective model of school learning  and the use of technology and the Internet in planning and presenting content. To practise as a regulated educational psychologist  there are certain accredited degrees you must possess. You will learn about the skills and responsibilities of an educational psychologist  as well as the qualification requirements.This course is designed for people working in the field of education who want to improve their teaching experience. It is also useful for psychologists who need to work with teachers  administrators or students to create healthy learning environments. Parents who want to understand the behaviour and developmental needs of their children will also find this course useful. There are no prerequisites to join this course  and anyone can opt in. The instructor carefully explains both the practical and theoretical aspects of education and psychology. Every school requires professionals to improve the quality of the learning process and resolve students’ psychological issues regarding their studies. Educational psychology offers a wide range of career opportunities such as school psychologists  training advisers and career consultants. Join this course now to build and improve your understanding of educational psychology and learn for free!

Commercial law  often known as ‘mercantile law’ or ‘trade law’  is the body of law that governs the conduct of people and businesses engaged in commerce. This body of law alleviates challenges and misunderstandings faced by economic actors. These laws are not created out of thin air but are the result of extensive and careful analysis conducted by groups of stakeholders and elected officials over the centuries. This course covers the core concepts of commercial law and shows you how these laws are enacted to affect local and international trade. We begin with a demonstration of how contracts are negotiated and drafted for various business transactions. We then examine the different judicial systems of the United Kingdom and compare them to the legal system of Northern Ireland. We explain how governments are formed and laws passed.Business organisations are often dependent on legal systems that govern contracts  trading and other commercial activity. We define ‘business organisations’ and compare ‘incorporated’ and ‘unincorporated’ companies. Individuals who share the same vision will sometimes come together to share a company's liabilities and profits. To achieve this aim  they might form a legal relationship known as a ‘partnership’  which is usually formed by a written agreement between two or more individuals or companies. We lay out the three types of partnerships and their characteristics. We then study the history and responsibilities of the UK Department of Trade and Industry. The course also covers the World Trade Organisation (WTO) and outlines its five guiding principles and some of the global providers of credit information.The course then introduces you to the UK Parliament’s Sales of Goods Act and how it regulates commercial and contract law with respect to goods that are sold and bought. We describe the legislative style used to promulgate UK legislation that defines consumer law  buyers' and sellers' legal duties and more. Finally  We discuss the role of the UK's competition law and explain how disputes between the Crown and the Parliament are resolved. A knowledge of commercial law is crucial for the proper functioning of a business and legal trade between individuals  corporations and nations. This course has no prerequisites and is designed for anyone interested in starting their own business or partnership. Sign to learn how to overcome the stumbling blocks you may encounter on your path to becoming a successful entrepreneur.

VIPs like politicians and movie stars are often exposed to harassment or attacks from the public. They require the services of a personal security agent or bodyguard to survive such situations and such protection demands specific skills  qualifications and extensive training. This course covers the roles and responsibilities of professional bodyguards.We begin with an in-depth examination of the function and mode of operation of a professional bodyguard and lay out the employee qualities sought by security companies. The course explains how close protection operates in the United Kingdom and goes over security agents’ specific training requirements. We study the relevant laws and regulations to demonstrate why personal bodyguards must always be able to accurately assess risks.The course provides techniques like extensive inspection  anti-ambush drills and on-foot protection. These techniques are presented with examples of real-life scenarios. We also go through basic anti-surveillance and emergency handling procedures. Finally  we discuss how Covid-19 has impacted close protection services around the world. If you enjoy protecting others and dealing with physical and challenging situations  then this line of work will suit you. Providing effective close protection requires more than muscle and sunglasses so sign up for this course to start training as a bodyguard.

The first five years of life are critical in a child's development. Early childhood care and education can influence a child's long-term social  cognitive  emotional and physical development. Early years teachers play an essential role in providing high-quality early education that helps to improve children’s development. Successful early years teachers require an in-depth understanding of the key principles and learning areas that affect childhood development and must know how to apply them to the early years foundation stage (EYFS). This course explains the philosophy behind the EYFS framework. We provide practical knowledge to help you perform the role of the EYFS teacher and appreciate the importance of early years education in driving a child’s development. We also guide you through the various paths you can take to acquire your Early Years Teacher Status (EYTS)  which will allow you to work with young children in the UK.The course then examines the EYFS learning framework and the UK government’s childcare strategy designed to establish it as the development framework provided to all young children in the country. We show you how and why children learn best through play and how EYFS teachers can use this technique to promote their development. You then explore the principles applied to special educational needs (SEN) teaching and the responsibilities of a SEN teacher. We demonstrate how to identify the different types of special educational needs in order to close the achievement gap between disadvantaged children and their peers. We guide you through the seven areas of learning to help you understand when to focus on each. These skills will help you to create an enabling learning environment and use different EYFS teaching techniques to keep children motivated as they achieve their learning goals.The course is aimed at teachers but is also ideal for parents and guardians who want to apply the EYFS framework to bring out the best in the children in their care. The EYFS framework can be applied to make you confident that you are meeting the standards that all early years teachers must meet in order to ensure that children learn and develop well. This course suits aspiring educators who want to work with young children and has no prerequisites. Even if you're already familiar with the EYFS framework  this course serves as a refresher and keeps you up to date with current pedagogical developments in the UK. The educational sector provides many job opportunities for EYFS specialists and acquiring the necessary skills allows you to do what you love while earning a living. Sign up to learn how to teach young children in the UK and acquire the skills required to guide young minds towards their full potential.

product_name: Positive Handling and Behavioural Training in Schools
description: Teachers and other educational personnel are frequently faced with challenging situations involving misbehaviour and sometimes brutal fights and thus require specialised training to deal with them. Only a well-trained person can deal calmly with such confrontations and find a solution. We outline the characteristics of this approach and lay out its levels designed for different educators. We identify the causes of challenging student behaviours and provide a range of techniques for managing them.The course outlines various de-escalation techniques and some verbal and nonverbal strategies for dealing with difficult students and situations. product_name: Introduction to Telemarketing and Sales Training
description: In today's market  managers are tasked with improving sales performance by training staff to improve their skills. Do you want to help clients regain their fitness  lose fat and build muscle? The course also demonstrates how to use signs for everyday words such as ‘bathroom’  ‘living room’ and their contents.We then explore the use of BSL to convey a variety of greetings  inquiries  opinions  introductions and taking-leave terms such as ‘hello  nice to meet you’  ‘my name is Emma’ and ‘see you soon’. After that  the course teaches you how to use sign language to describe various individuals  your family  pets or other animals. We demonstrate how to use BSL and its unique grammar that differs from English’s to talk about your mother's name  your look  your pet's characteristics or your family members.The course shows you how to combine different signs to discuss the weather and modes of transportation to create a dialogue. Finally  we outline the BSL gestures used to identify colours  sizes  numbers and time. This introductory BSL course is taught by a teacher with over twenty years’ experience and helps you to develop your ability to communicate with other sign language users while also improving access and inclusion for deaf people. Enrol now to learn a valuable new skill and add sign language to your professional portfolio.

product_name: Stock Investment Criteria for a Great Company
description: The internet lets investors easily access free  real-time data with the click of a button but selecting the appropriate information for assessing and evaluating a specific stock remains a challenge. Although the stock market can appear random at times  making good investment decisions is a science. Professional investors consider key criteria when deciding whether to invest in a stock or not and this investment course teaches you how to do the same to reduce the risk and stress of making such decisions.We want our students at Stewardship Finance Academy to discover the next great companies that will compound shareholder returns over the next two to five years. We provide a set of eight primary and three secondary factors used to evaluate any investment and identify undervalued great companies. These eleven criteria should not be viewed in isolation but complement each other to allow you to assess and predict a company's market position.The course discusses the specifics of these criteria to show you how they can be harnessed to evaluate the company and its potential. We help you to stop thinking of the stock market as a game of chance as these criteria clarifies and rationalises your buy and sell decisions. Sign up to learn how to read online metrics and make informed investment decisions using the same criteria employed by experts and moguls.

product_name: Mastering the Basics of Microsoft Excel
description: Many people and organisations always use spreadsheet applications to handle various data visualisation tasks. Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel are among today’s most popular and useful programs. This course explains how to use Microsoft Excel to boost productivity. We begin with the basics such as installing and starting up Excel  saving a workbook and changing preferences and formatting elements to suit your needs. We then examine the use of formulas and comparison operators in Excel. Some people find it difficult to work with Excel so this course uses simple terms to explain how to perform each function step by step. We demonstrate how to print a workbook and manage your passwords in Excel. We then go through the use of important advanced spreadsheet features like ‘IF’ functions.This Excel tutorial provides a strong understanding of the program and the skills that make you a spreadsheet expert. These data visualisation skills can also be applied with Google Sheets and boost your professional value in most career fields. Most white collar jobs require some familiarity with spreadsheets so sign up for this MS Excel tutorial to become the office expert with invaluable skills.

product_name: ISO 45003:2021:  Psychological Health and Safety at Work
description: Organizations and companies take specific steps to identify and reduce any health and safety hazards their workers might face. Unfortunately  many employers overlook the deterioration of mental and psychosocial wellbeing associated with work because of a lack of awareness and failure of standardized practices. The advent of ISO 45003  formulated by the International Organization for Standardization in 2021  established the importance of mental health in the workplace.This standard is one of the latest developments in the organizational health and safety (OH&S) field. It was developed to help organizations identify and manage any risks that may threaten the psychosocial wellbeing of employees. The ISO 45993 standard is still new and requires explanation so the experts at Exoexcellence Consultants have developed this course to help you understand its requirements and nuances.This course benefits industrial OH&S experts and managers who are responsible for the health and safety of employees. It consists of two modules divided into several topics  starting with an overview to introduce you to the standard. We then examine it clause-by-clause to provide the training you need to ensure compliance and create a healthy corporate culture. We also include two summaries in the ‘Resources’ section to help you apply the standard in your organization. Sign up to learn how the ISO 45003 standard can be harnessed to protect the mental health of those around you in the workplace and add another element to your professional portfolio.

Do you want to know the insider secrets used by experts to write flawless content that captivates their audience? This course helps you to avoid careless typos and grammatical blunders as you master copyediting. We provide the skills you need to become a skilled copy-editor capable of preparing documents for publication.The course then describes the core abilities  theoretical knowledge and qualifications necessary to perform more difficult copyediting duties. We demonstrate how to perform pre-publication checks on both digital and print articles. We show you how to rapidly spot grammatical mistakes  verify the validity of data  edit language to make it easier to read and more.Whatever your current level of proficiency in writing English  this course helps you build or update your ability to work as an editorial staff member in the field of publishing. This training widens your editing portfolio but also helps you become a better writer overall  offering you the flexibility to edit fiction  nonfiction found on a wide variety of platforms  from novels to websites. These skills are key in publishing but are also useful in any field that demands excellent written communication. The careful use of language says a lot about your diligence and professionalism so sign up for this copyediting course to master English grammar and pick up the writing skills required to clean up text and make a good impression.

product_name: A Comprehensive Guide for Voiceover Artists
description: Have you ever wondered how voice actors can command the attention of a crowd for hours without losing their voice? This free online voiceover training course teaches you the skills and techniques used to motivate the audience in any recording context. We introduce you to the basics of voiceover performance and identify the qualities that define a successful voice actor. Learn how to turn your voiceover skills into a career.The course breaks down the steps taken to understand your audience as you read and interpret scripts to make sure you deliver the copy effectively. We help you discover your unique voice and explain how to use it to create engaging and unique characters.
