We demonstrate how to breathe correctly to create a powerful voice and capture emotional expression. Do you ever feel like no one wants to listen to you? We cover voice training exercises designed to improve your ability to deliver quality performances. We root out bad vocal habits and speech problems and show you how to eliminate them.We provide crucial tips for maintaining a healthy voice and explain how to set up your recording studio. We go over the steps used to set up the recording process and define relevant technical terms. Finally  we explore the UK’s voice acting industry to help you find rewarding opportunities to allow you to showcase your newfound skills. This voiceover course has no prerequisites and improves your resume and chance of establishing your professional value. Sign up to turn your voice into an asset and explore the exciting world of spoken performance.

product_name: Intermediate Chemistry: Periodicity and Periodic Table
description: Dmitri Mendeleev arranged elements by atomic mass (the sum of protons and neutrons) and the modern Periodic Table orders them by atomic number (the number of protons or electrons in a neutral atom). We begin by identifying the eighteen ‘groups’ (vertical columns) and seven ‘periods’ (horizontal rows) found in today's Periodic Table. We study four (‘s’  ‘p’  ‘d’ and ‘f’) block elements  their location in the Periodic Table and their subshells filling. We then examine the placement of metals  metalloids and non-metals and their properties.The course then delves into the periodicity of physical properties  beginning with atomic radii. We then explain how melting points and conductivity across periods are affected by the type of element and formed bonds. For example  metals have high melting points because they form powerful metallic bonds while non-metals have lower melting points because they make up simple molecules. Our next topic describes how a higher electronegativity in period 3 increases the first ionisation energy of non-metals relative to metals.We trace the effect of changes in valence electrons on various chemical properties across the Periodic Table. We outline how period 3 elements like sodium  magnesium and sulphur react with hydrogen and produce golden yellow  bright and blue flames while forming oxides. We demonstrate how quickly or slowly metals  non-metals and metalloids react with chlorine to form chlorides. Finally  we explain how some period 3 chlorides  such as sodium and magnesium  dissociate in water into ions while others  like silicon and phosphorus  hydrolyse and emit white fumes. This course has no prerequisites and is designed for anyone who wants to improve their chemistry skills. Sign up to explore the building blocks of matter and learn how to arrange elements on the Periodic Table.

product_name: Learn English: The Media and Questions in Indirect Speech
description: This English course introduces you to some basic vocabulary related to mass media  allowing you to report on what's happening in the news. We provide opportunities to read  listen to  and repeat these new words and phrases  helping you improve your English pronunciation. We also include a reading activity that shows you how to use your new vocabulary in the context of mass media and current events. The grammar section of this course reviews the use of direct speech and reminds you of the three formats in which you may write them. We then introduce you to the use and application of indirect speech and the rules governing its structure. We explain how to change direct speech into indirect speech using various verbs  adverbs  modals  and 'wh-' words. The exercises in the 'Student Practice' section are designed to help you revise your reading  listening  and speaking skills while drawing on the knowledge you have gained from all topics in this course. The downloadable writing task  found in this course's 'Resources' section  will allow you to write and structure three paragraphs of text into a short news article. Sign up to learn how to use indirect speech and impress your friends with your newfound ability to discuss the news in English.

Water (H2O) is a clear  odourless  tasteless liquid that freezes at 32°F or 0°C and boils at 212°F or 100°C. It is essential for health  food production and environmental management. This course teaches you the chemistry of water and water purification processes. We examine water’s basic properties  such as alkalinity and ‘hardness’  and lay out the fundamental principles used in its treatment.The course breaks down each step of water purification  including neutralisation and the flotation and reduction processes. We study water’s inorganic substances and conduct a chemical analysis of major and minor ions. We explain how to control the health impacts of volatile organic compounds and synthetic organic compounds. The course then moves on to metalloids  the effects of heavy metals and the pollution control measures used to mitigate them. Finally  we explain how to implement a chemical hygiene plan and employ effective safety measures in the laboratory.The importance of safe drinking water in promoting health cannot be overstated. Chemical contamination has been identified as one of the most significant water pollutants and poses a serious health risk. This course explains water purification processes by exploring the chemistry and treatment principles that drive them. We also identify the conditions that water must meet before it can be safely drunk. Sign up to improve your understanding of the chemistry of water and the treatment and purification process that make it safe for human consumption. These principles are crucial in civil engineering efforts to protect our most precious natural resource.

The era of smart contracts and cryptocurrency transactions is here to stay. Bitcoin was one of the first cryptocurrency platforms to be developed but several better platforms have since appeared. EOS Blockchain is one of the most refined blockchain technologies that specialises in smart contracts and cryptocurrency transactions. This course covers the fundamental concepts of EOS Blockchain’s technology so you can quickly begin creating your own smart contracts and cryptocurrencies using its features to create distributed blockchain-enabled applications. The first module begins with an overview of the course structure. We then proceed to address the concepts crucial to EOS Blockchain  which was developed to address the shortcomings of other blockchain networks. To gain widespread use  applications on the blockchain require a platform that is flexible enough to meet several requirements  which we discuss. The course then outlines the basics of blockchain  security and crypto-economics.What do ‘accounts’ and ‘wallets’ mean in the context of EOS? The EOS ‘wallet’ may be viewed as a repository for the public-private key pairs needed to sign blockchain transactions in the EOS system. Unlike other cryptocurrencies  EOS has a distinct structure for accounts. Depending on the account  some operations may be handled on a ‘pass/fail’ basis without altering the internal state of the account. We examine ‘read-only’ action handlers  atomic transactions  the EOS testnet and the EOS toolset.Over time  EOS apps have distinguished themselves as the quicker  cheaper and safer alternatives to conventional blockchain apps. According to the current trends  EOS has emerged as a real champion of blockchain technology and can offer enormous benefits for a variety of business demands in the future. This course provides the training you need to create your own cryptocurrency with the EOS Blockchain platform. This course has no prerequisites and suits both novice and veteran users of blockchain technology. Sign up to improve your cryptocurrency and app development skills with EOS Blockchain.

This child development course discusses the importance of morality  selfishness and ethical behaviour in early childhood. We also establish the importance of scruples and altruism and lay out various critical theories of moral development. We explain in depth how moral development follows a recognised sequence and develops simultaneously with cognitive development. We examine Lawrence Kohlberg's theory of moral development and investigate the impact of a child’s environment on their behaviour. We then compare it to Carol Gilligan's emphasis on compassion and love in shaping young minds.This course explores the moral aspect of the development of personality and character. We trace the connection between innate characteristics like self-awareness  self-control and self-consciousness that shape someone’s personality. We study Abraham Maslow’s self-actualisation theory of personality in detail. The course then delves into various stages of early childhood development  beginning with the ‘anal’ and ‘oral’ periods. We then examine the ‘latent’ period  during which children are most interested in learning  before moving on to the ‘genital’ period. We show you how sexual maturation affects childhood behavior.Our next section focuses on the biological development of organs  tissues and hormones in children as they reach sexual maturity. We discuss how sexual feelings  beliefs and behaviours are determined to be ‘appropriate’ for a certain age. We compare the behaviorist and cognitive perspectives of sexual development to explain the concept of gender identity as and cover the emotional  physical and social aspects of a child’s sexual development. This psychology course is ideal for parents  preschool teachers or psychologists who want to develop their understanding of the early development of personality. Sign up to compare different models used to understand how the foundations for adult morality are laid in childhood and pick up practical tips that guide children towards better decisions.

Are you a teacher or parent who wants to help children develop the mental tools required to focus  plan and execute tasks effectively? If so  this child psychology course on the development of executive functions during early childhood is for you. We provide a definition of ‘executive functions’ and identify its key components. We then trace the different stages of their development as children grow and begin their formal education.One of the most crucial elements in ensuring that a child develops executive functions properly is to understand the factors that affect their development. We analyse these factors in detail as teachers and parents require the right tools and information to judge whether executive functions are developing in children. We provide such techniques and explain how to encourage mental development when help is needed.The course studies various approaches and theories developed by renowned psychologists over the years to help you nurture early cognitive progress in children. Executive functions are extremely important to children and it is crucial that you equip yourself with the right tools to make sure you make a difference in your home or classroom. This child psychology course provides practical techniques you can employ to foster childhood development and encourage the kind of thinking and planning that makes future leaders.

Toilet training helps children to manage their pee and faeces while awake or sleep. It teaches them how to recognise the need for the toilet without adult prompting and shows them how to use it successfully and independently and follow hygiene guidelines. We begin this course by studying the history of toilet training and establishing its importance. We also describe the first stages of toilet training and trace the psychological development of toddlers. We explain how the body’s systems develop and define terms like ‘assisted baby toilet training’.The course then explores various approaches to toilet training  including the Brazelton Method. We examine different types of operant conditioning  including the use of physiological features. We answer key questions like ‘how can parents prepare for toilet training?’ and ‘when can I start toilet training my child?’. This course provides the techniques and tools you need to successfully train your child to use the toilet. We examine the everyday experience of toilet training and trace the factors affecting it to show you how parents can prepare for the experience. This course has no prerequisites and suits anyone who wants to develop the important childcare skill of toilet training and learn its significance in early child development. Sign up to help your child move on from diapers and make your lives easier and less messy!

product_name: Comprehensive Guide to Becoming a Counsellor
description: Psychological counselling aims to improve patients’ lives and help them address serious mental health problems by using information and short-term treatments (as opposed to psychotherapy  which takes longer). This course introduces you to the duties of counsellors and lays out the principles used in psychological counselling. We then examine UK legislation related to mental health that provides the framework that safeguards the rights of people suffering from psychiatric issues. We also outline the code of ethics governing professional counsellors. Children and adolescents are more likely than adults to suffer from certain mental health issues that impact their development and routine life activities. We study these problems and explain how to treat them. All personalities contain negative traits but people with personality disorders display negative traits in extreme and unhealthy ways. We explore the causes and symptoms of such personality disorders and lay out the counselling practices used to treat such mental ailments before moving on to substance abuse  anxiety and stress.Depression is a long-lasting low mood that can occur for a variety of reasons. We investigate the causes and symptoms of depression and related mood disorders and provide the appropriate counselling techniques to address them. We then go through the causes and symptoms of sleeping and eating disorders before describing treatment options. The course then discusses the role of career counsellors in helping clients make informed professional decisions. In similar vein  we describe how couple counselling can help clients understand the dynamics of their relationship through effective communication and collaboration. We explore the scope and techniques of couple and family counselling to help your clients resolve their disputes. We demonstrate how to help clients develop coping skills to deal with immediate crises like the loss of a loved one  divorce and relocation.We designed this course for people who want to pursue a career in counselling. This course is also useful for professional counsellors who want to improve their knowledge and expertise in counselling to provide more effective input. There is no prerequisite knowledge or experience required to take this course and anyone interested in understanding and treating mental disorders can take the course. The instructor explains both the theoretical and practical portions of counselling. According to the World Health Organization (WHO)  anxiety and depression have significantly increased since the Covid-19 pandemic. This emphasises the need for more mental health practitioners and counsellors so there are job opportunities for people with the right skills. Sign up to become one of them and learn how to turn your talent for listening and giving advice into a rewarding career as a counsellor.

product_name: Learn English: Regrets and Past Perfect Tense
description: This detailed English language course begins by teaching you words related to shopping and the emotions experienced when buying in stores. The various topics feature articles  videos  and audio clips to help you practice your new vocabulary and skills so you become more proficient in English.The course's first grammar topic reviews the forms and uses of the past perfect tense and explains how to use the perfect modals like 'should have' and 'ought to have' to express regret. Our second grammar lesson demonstrates how to form positive and negative sentences that express regret and how to frame questions using 'wish' and 'if only' in the past perfect tense.The final section enhances your ability to read  write and speak English. It focuses on specific words and phrases you can use to describe the experience of shopping - which includes the regret one sometimes feels after spending money  called 'buyer's remorse.' The writing activities allow you to immediately practice what you have learned as you work on your newfound skills and vocabulary. We have designed this course to help you progress quickly  getting you conversing with others  which is the best way to gain confidence as you master English.

Are you concerned about your child's changing behaviour? It is important that parents and caregivers understand children’s development to help them improve. Child psychology studies the developmental stages of childhood  children’s relationships with others and the role of affection. This course helps you to understand how children learn  think  feel and interact with others. We begin by introducing you to the field of child psychology and explain its important role in understanding and driving childhood development. We illustrate how mental health problems affect young people and highlight the correlating educational challenges they raise in the classroom. We then break down the concept of ‘attachment’ and examine the different theories that explain it. We discuss the effects of bereavement and divorce on children of different ages before studying various attachment disorders and their treatments. The course traces the stages of child development that almost all children go through and demonstrates how to best support them through each stage. We outline factors that can cause problematic development in children and discuss in detail different parenting styles to help you understand how best to raise your children. We study various personality traits  psychosocial stages and development concepts to explain childhood problems and challenges and how to deal with them. The course then introduces you to the concept of child neglect  laying out its signs  risk factors and impact on children's physical and mental health to help you prevent it. We also show you how to identify and respond to internet addiction among children.The course then discusses issues faced during adolescence and their appropriate therapies. We teach you how to identify common teenage mental health problems like anxiety disorders  eating disorders  mood disorders  autism spectrum disorder and more. We also explore substance abuse and lay out its effects on physical and psychological development. Finally  we examine the psychotherapeutic and psychopharmacological approaches to improving childhood mental health. This course is important for professional psychologists  parents  teachers  caregivers or anyone interested in learning about child psychology. Sign up to learn the principles of child psychology and how to apply them in your work with children.

Art therapy is a type of psychotherapy that uses art as a way to help people express themselves. It can be used to help people deal with stress  anxiety and mental health issues. This course introduces you to art therapy and its concepts and explains how to work with clients who have physical and mental impairments. We explore the history and principles of art therapy and highlight some of the key figures in its evolution. We then study the key types of art therapy  including individual and group therapy  and show you how to effectively incorporate it into your professional psychotherapy practice. This course also suits anyone who simply wants to broaden their horizons and investigate the value of art therapy in their lives.Creativity is a powerful tool that can be used to help improve mental health and wellbeing and art therapy offers one way to tap into your creative side. We discuss creative therapy and its uses and lay out some of the different types of innovative treatments. We define ‘mindful creativity’ and emphasise the importance of mindfulness and mindfulness practices like meditation. The course goes over art therapy techniques that you could use with clients  the necessary materials and their goals. We focus on the use of drawing and demonstrate how art therapy can be employed as a kind of treatment for kids who have physical and mental impairments.The course explains how to use art therapy to treat families and guides you through some of the most common mental illnesses you're likely to encounter as an art therapist. We provide some useful recording techniques you can use with your clients and cover the basics of supervision and its boundaries and therapeutic limitations. This course is designed for anyone interested in learning about the growing field of art therapy and how to work with clients who have physical and mental impairments. Whether you are a professional psychotherapist looking to improve your ability to help your clients or are simply interested in learning how creativity can improve mental health  this course is for you.

Elderly  sick and disabled people often require care and support to live happily. Compassionate and well-organised professional care assistants support people in this position to help them lead fulfilling lives. They help clients keep track of care plans and meet all necessary requirements to ensure that they are well cared for without complications. Their day-to-day tasks include assisting clients with prescribed medication  mobility  personal care and hygiene. This course teaches you the duties and responsibilities of a care assistant and explains how to deliver top-notch care services to clients.The course distinguishes between the three elements of health care and the four aspects of social care provided by care assistants. We then identify who provides social care services to service users and the steps taken to do so. Care assistants who work with food must adhere to food safety and hygiene practices. This is because all food handlers are required by law to understand and implement food hygiene practices in order to protect the food they serve from contamination. We examine the laws that govern food safety in the United Kingdom  how these laws are enforced by food safety officers  what is expected of food business owners under these laws and what might happen when they contravene the laws. We also discuss food poisoning  its cause  symptoms and control measures.The course explains the concept of equality  the duties of a health and social care worker  the relevant codes of conduct and how to safeguard vulnerable individuals. We establish the importance of communication and outline how to identify vulnerable children. We show you how to make decisions for people that face difficulty in making their own  the principles of service delivery and legal responsibilities in health and social care. Lastly  we define common medical terms and lay out the important roles technology plays in health care. There are no prerequisites for taking this course and it is designed for all learners. A career in health and social care allows you to help people who are infirm  elderly or sick. Sign up to turn your compassion into a career and make a real difference in the lives of vulnerable people while protecting their wellbeing and dignity.

Are you interested in a career that takes you outdoors and engages your mathematical and observation skills? If so  you may find land surveying to be a rewarding career. This course is designed by the online education platform Skill Up to provide the training you need to become a land surveyor who determines land size as accurately as possible before any construction work can begin. We begin with an overview of the job and its requirements and earning potential.The course then analyses the different instruments and techniques used to perform surveying tasks. We explore topographic surveying and mapping  which are surveys that locate the horizontal and vertical positions of the surface features of a specific geographic area. We then study boundary surveying. Contrary to popular belief  land surveyors do not establish boundary lines but merely act to document actual land sections and features. We explain how this works in detail.Finally  we lay out the vital health and safety precautions you should take on the job and go through the Code of Safe Surveying Practices. The course also demonstrates how to use personal protective equipment and emphasises the importance of personal responsibility while describing the role of supervisors in keeping workers safe. Land surveying is a crucial step in the preparation of any construction project and this engineering course provides all the essential skills you need to enter this fascinating field.

Enthusiasm  commitment and perseverance are three important elements of leadership  which leads to effective teamwork between committed colleagues. Successful teams are characterised by a team spirit based on trust  mutual respect  helpfulness and friendliness. In this short management training course  we study the tenets and practices common to high-performing teams.The course explains how leaders can instil optimism  ensure efficient use of resources and boost their team's morale and performance. We study different types of teams and identify the best practices used to establish group norms in an organisation. We demonstrate how to develop strategic  tactical  operational and contingency plans to get your team through any type of difficult situation. We then go over several leadership styles to help you refine your interactions and influence colleagues to give their best. Learn how to use social ‘people skills’ to foster teamwork  manage conflict and build trust.This course is designed to help you develop the conceptual skills required to analyse a complex situation by ‘thinking outside the box’. We lay out the seven key indicators of high motivation and explain how to apply them in the workplace to motivate your colleagues. We also delve into the management of talent  stress  mental health and succession planning as ‘transformational leadership’ requires a holistic approach to meeting your employees’ needs. The course also provides practical tips to help you master negotiation techniques  time and conflict management  risk management and virtual team coordination. Sign up for this management training course to acquire the transformational leadership skills you need to take your team to new heights and advance your career.

product_name: Office Procedures in the Modern Workplace
description: Do you want to work in an office and need to enhance your professional business skills? Office personnel hold their organisation together and ensure that things run smoothly. This administration course is taught by Sherique Dill  an office management expert with over twenty years’ experience  and is designed to be engaging and straightforward to help you learn the best office skills in a few hours.The course begins with a simple definition of ‘office’ as we lay out their various types. We will then discuss the basic functions of a modern office and explain how to become an outstanding receptionist who respects confidentiality and keeps the reception area safe. We then delve into office support  office terminology  filing systems and equipment used for data processing.We conclude with the all-important topic of workplace communication. We examine the various ways we can communicate effectively to provide the communication skills you need to succeed in a white collar environment. We trace the impact of emotions on communication and establish the importance of receiving feedback. You can download study notes from our ‘Resources’ section to help you master these skills and provide useful information for later reference. Sign up for this office administration course to learn the basic skills you need to prosper in the corporate workplace.

product_name: Easy Steps to Becoming a Medical Receptionist
description: Medical receptionists engage with patients or clients who book appointments  inquire about billing or visit medical settings for an appointment. This course teaches you the principles of good record-keeping  the types of files and how to store medical records. We examine effective filing systems and provide crucial guidelines for setting them up. We then go through the ethical standards and confidentiality and security concerns within the medical context  which includes details as to when you can disclose confidential information without consent.The course also explains how to order medical supplies and check deliveries and storage considerations. We demonstrate how to stay safe in the workplace  avoid certain diseases and take fire precautions. We outline how customer service works differently in medicine and show you how to handle aggression and anxiety in the workplace. The course then delves into the use of information technology and computers in the healthcare industry. We lay out the use of clinical coding  sources of coding errors and methods used to reduce them. We investigate the specifics of medical billing to help you establish who is paying for each medical service.Finally  medical receptionists need to be able to work with medical staff and patients from different backgrounds and we explain how to do so. This course boosts your confidence by providing up-to-date information of each aspect of the job  from understanding the importance of confidentiality to legal issues surrounding patient rights. This course is suitable for medical receptionists who want to develop their skills  medical students and anyone looking for a formal qualification and entry point into the field. It is also beneficial for those interested in an administrative position in the healthcare industry.

This management training course explains emotional intelligence (EI) and its role in the workplace. We begin by exploring the history progression of this idea and comparing it to the traditional perception of intelligence quotient (IQ). We compare the different models used to understand EI before exploring their practical significance in the workplace.The course traces the relationship between EI and job performance. We identify which EI metrics are more accurate predictors of job performance. We then describe the impact of EI on employees’ work-life balance. The course defines concepts like ‘emotional labour’  ‘deep acting’ and ‘surface acting’. We also lay out the causes and symptoms of emotional exhaustion and outline their impact on job performance.We unpack the role of EI in the context of leadership to provide the training you require to bring out the best in those around you. We compare task-oriented and socio-emotional behaviours and lay out the characteristics of authentic leaders capable of employing empathy  priming and an enriched emotional vocabulary to manage conflict and encourage excellence. This course demonstrates the use of proper emotional expression and regulation to help you improve your EI and harness it as valuable professional skill. Sign up to learn how to bring out the best in yourself and those around you.

Learn how to use herbs and their roots to address a variety of common medical conditions like high blood pressure and low immunity. This professional herbalist training course teaches you everything you need to know about the healing qualities and uses of herbs and plant chemistry. We explore the history of traditional Chinese herbal treatments and explain how to harness the power of nature. We compare these methods to those employed in India and the Middle East.We provide the skills required to work in a variety of professions ranging from medicine to the beauty industry. This course also trains you to work in wellness counselling  aromatherapy and holistic health teaching at home or as a qualified professional.This course is designed for students with no prior knowledge of herbal medicine and has no prerequisites. Please note that you should seek medical help during emergencies as herbalism does not replace traditional medicine but complements it. People all over the world have long used herbs to improve their health  looks and mental wellbeing so sign up for this herbalism course to learn how to employ natural healthcare methods that have existed for millennia.

Do you want to take control of your business’ finances? Xero accounting software is popular worldwide as it offers small to medium companies reliable bookkeeping and financial planning capabilities. It is hosted in the cloud and simplifies the process of managing payroll and meeting your fiduciary responsibilities to stakeholders.This course is designed primarily for students with no prior expertise in accounting and offers training broken down into manageable segments. We cover the fundamental aspects of Xero and explain how to use the software to perform a wide range of accounting activities  including adjusting the nominal ledger  completing a VAT return  reconciling the bank and more.After completing this training and receiving the relevant certification  you will be able to use the business accounting features of Xero like a true professional  either as a financial accountant  bookkeeping assistant  business administrator or even an accounts assistant. We offer the most in-demand accounting skills taught by people at the top of their fields. Sign up to learn how to use Xero’s cloud-based accounting software and its many features to handle your finances and simplify bookkeeping.

‘Child neglect’ is the persistent failure of a parent or caregiver to provide basic needs for a child  resulting in serious harm. Did you know that one in ten children in the UK experiences suffering borne of carelessness? This course outlines the causes of child neglect to help you to provide appropriate responses to the issue. We break down the physical  behavioural and environmental signs of neglect and explain how to assess the risk factors at the parent  family and community levels to discover why it is occurring.We then examine the effects of child neglect and provide measures that help protect children against maltreatment. We discuss some child neglect cases to help you develop a better understanding of these measures and how to apply them in real life. The course equips you with the competence to implement the United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child and the UK legislation to combat neglect. We also identify the UK authorities responsible for child protection.Finally  the course explains how to report and respond to child neglect concerns. We lay out the categories of prevention measures and discuss the importance of public awareness of the dangers of child neglect and the responsibility of schools  families and the public. This comprehensive childcare course is open to anyone concerned about the wellbeing of children. Sign up to enrich your social work skills and learn what to do when you suspect that a child is being neglected.

product_name: Intermediate Chemistry: Halogens & Alkaline Earth Metals
description: Magnesium  one of the group 2 elements  is used in fireworks due to the bright white flashes formed when it burns in the presence of oxygen. Find more about magnesium and the rest of the group’s elements in this course. The first module is about alkaline earth metals  including beryllium  magnesium  calcium  barium  strontium and radium  which are located in the second column of the periodic table. Discover how they form metallic bonds  and how the atomic numbers increase going down group 2  which increases the nuclear charge. Adding an extra shell down the group increases the shielding effect  causing a decrease in the melting points. After that  we investigate the chemistry of group 2 elements and how they form basic oxides that partially dissolve in water  forming alkaline or slightly alkaline solutions.The flame test  used to differentiate elements based on their different emission colours using a non-luminous Bunsen flame  is then described. Next  we contrast the solubilities of group 2 sulphates and hydroxides  as well as the decomposition of group 2 carbonates and nitrates  which results in the formation of oxides. Calcium carbonate occurs in nature in many forms; the two most common are limestone and marble  used in building houses for bricks or floors.The next module covers group 17 elements  known as halogens  which are found in the column before the last on the right side of the periodic table. You'll notice that fluorine and chlorine are gases  bromine is a liquid  and iodine and astatine are solids at room temperature. Then you'll understand how  as you move down group 17  the atomic number rises  causing the atomic radius and Van der Waals forces to increase. After that  we explore the reactions of halogens with metals and hydrogen gas to form ionic compounds and halogen halides  as well as how we can use silver nitrate to distinguish between various halide ions. The course concludes with halogens industrial applications  including the chlorination of water and the production of bleach and PVC. Enrolment is free and there is optional certification available.

This course explains how to reduce debt using financial planning and budgeting. We define basic financial terms like ‘credit’ and ‘debt’ and identify their various types. We lay out the pros and cons of debt management and establish its role in taking control of your personal finances. The course then compares long-term and short-term debt and shows you how to assess your financial situation.A debt management plan will help you to pay off your debts in a planned and secure way. We explain what a debt management plan is  how it works and how to enrol. We then go through its process step by step. To understand how much debt you are in  you have to learn some terms and calculations to avoid further damage and employ the right methods to reduce your debt. We demonstrate how to assess your debts and provide some strategies to reduce them. The course then moves on to the process of debt financing.Budgeting is an essential money management tool used to escape debt. We break down the process of creating a monthly budget for your household. We also show you how to differentiate between ‘good’ and ‘bad’ debt before discussing debt collectors  debt counselling and the role of bankruptcy and insolvency. Our final section discusses laws and regulations related to debt. Good financial planning can save you money and stress so sign up for this personal finance course to learn how to manage and get out of debt.

This course provides a broad overview of social sciences  the academic disciplines that study society and the human world (also called the ‘humanities’). We explain what defines ‘social sciences’ and explore their history and evolution. After outlining the relevant disciplines  we discuss the role of scientific theory and the scientific method in research conducted into social subjects and philosophy.We discuss the branches of social science in detail  from sociology  economics and history to anthropology  mass communication and more. We identify the role played by each of these subjects in our society and describe their historical evolution. We also examine the interaction between these disciplines as the social sciences seek to explain the complexities of human behaviour. Research is a major part of academic pursuit and we lay out the basics of research methodology to help you begin on your path towards effective scholarship.The course establishes the important role of the social sciences in modern society as they form a crucial part of modern science and philosophy. We analyse this relationship in depth as the social sciences cover vast subject areas and is its own profession. Whether you want to pursue this career path or simply want to satisfy your personal curiosity of the human world  this course provides a solid foundation on which to build your expertise. Sign up for this social science course to gain a broad perspective on the many interacting academic disciplines that explain the complexities of human behaviour.

product_name: Signs of Substance Abuse and What to Do
description: This course lays out the symptoms arising from the abuse of various narcotic substances and the mental health disorders associated with them. We explain some critical factors that drive substance misuse and discuss the signs of addiction and ways to prevent it. We then lay out the effects of specific substances on mental health in the long and short term and compare legal and illegal substances.The course explores prevention principles and explains how to recognise signs of substance abuse. We demonstrate how a reduction of drug intake lowers the health risks involved. We then examine some common workplace policies regarding substance misuse designed to protect employee health and safety. The course then examines the major elements of such policy and establishes the need to review and monitor them regularly. We provide a range of treatment options used to treat addiction.Our final section covers the UK laws and various Acts related to substance abuse  starting with the Misuse of Drug Act’s classification of various narcotic and psychoactive substances. We examine the causes and effects of substance abuse among the youth to provide a holistic understanding of drugs as a public health problem. Our analysis includes details on specific substances such as cocaine and heroin. This healthcare and social work course suits anyone who wants to learn more about drug addiction and its treatment. Sign up to learn how to support those struggling with substance abuse and help them find the right treatment option.

Criminal intelligence analysts are responsible for identifying patterns of criminal behaviour. Their job is challenging but there are recognised approaches to success. This criminology course teaches you the fundamentals of criminal intelligence  including how to collect  evaluate and analyse data to make sense of it. We then provide the specific skills required to become a criminal intelligence analyst. Understanding criminal psychology is critical in solving complex cases because it links suspects' mindset and motives to their actions. We examine different types of crimes and trace the psychological and social factors behind them. The criminal justice system considers evidence from crime research when making decisions and knowing how to apply a variety of research techniques is essential if you want evidence to stand up in court. We go over a range of research and analysis techniques and explain how to use them to research crime.Decision-making is one the most difficult parts of crime intelligence analysis  especially when the available data is incomplete and out of context. This course shows you how to make decisions when the available data is ambiguous or incomplete under different circumstances. We describe the unique features of intelligence-led policing and establish the importance in controlling modern crime. Specialist counterterrorism measures have been taken by governments around the world since the 9/11 attacks. We demonstrate how intelligence can be used to predict terrorist activities and go through the information required to create a counterterrorism policy and respond to a terrorist threat. The course teaches you how to use information technology to collect the required data  analyse it and use it to conduct smart investigations. We also discuss the key features of the criminal justice system of England and Wales.We designed this course for people who work or intend to work in law enforcement agencies as criminal intelligence analysts. It is also useful for anyone who has studied criminology or criminal intelligence and wants to refresh their knowledge. The instructor explains both the theoretical and practical aspects of criminal intelligence as well as the relevant laws. You can also take this course to learn how to precinct crime and guard against it. All governments and security agencies need professionals who can interpret crime data so criminal intelligence offers rewarding career opportunities for people with the right knowledge and skills. Sign up to learn how to analyse criminal data to detect patterns and predict future criminal behaviour.

product_name: A Practical Guide to Performance Management
description: When the clock is ticking towards a looming deadline  it can feel as if there aren’t enough hours in the day. In such situations  pressure-induced panic can lead to poor quality work. Pressure is an inevitable part of our daily lives but thinking and acting sensibly while stressed is not easy. If you can maintain your cool in a challenging  high-pressure situation and manage your performance  you will be in a better position to lead your team to success. Conversely  failure to cope with increased anxiety may hurt your performance. If you are a manager or a team leader  you not only need to optimise your own mindset and performance but must also make sure your stressed colleagues can produce their best work. In this management training course  we help you to develop the skills required to manage the stress that comes with working under pressure  counteract its negative effects and use strategies that can help your team excel.Pressure not only create negative effects but too much of it can be harmful. We explore the psychology of pressure and trace its effects on performance. We identify situations that trigger the pressure that leads to stress and explain how to manage both. Communication breakdowns among employees are common when pressure rises  leading to poor performance and workplace conflict. Pressure can also elicit psychological reactions like anxiety  panic attacks and anger. We walk you through the coping mechanisms that can help you relieve the pressure felt by your team. We also explain how to plan ahead  anticipate risks and smooth your path to your goals  all of which will make work less stressful and harrowing.Leaders play an important role in shaping organisational culture and we describe the qualities and skills of a good leader. We compare ‘real leaders’ and ‘safe leaders’ and provide methods you can use to build a resilient team  manage its energy levels  cultivate a ‘success mentality’  produce quality work and meet deadlines. We trace the link between work-related stress and productivity and introduce you to its triggers before outlining proven stress management techniques. Finally  we go through the legal duties of employers to manage stress set out in both Statutory and Common laws of the UK. Ability to handle pressure often defines the difference between a successful and an unsuccessful person. This management training course provides the leadership principles and skills you need to flourish under pressure and manage a successful team. Sign up to learn the psychology of stress and bring out the best in your team as you lead it to success.

product_name: Learn English: Health and Wellness with Mixed Conditionals
description: In this English course  we will introduce you to vocabulary related to health  wellness  and healthcare. Not only will there be a focus on common health issues and disorders but also on a variety of treatments that could help manage or potentially cure these conditions.We then use your newly acquired words and phrases to demonstrate the grammatical rules surrounding conditionals. We explain using zero  first  second  and third conditionals in statements  negatives  and question forms. We then go over the use of mixed conditionals and show you how to combine third/second and second/third conditionals. This particular grammar point will focus on using these mixed conditionals to discuss how past actions impact the present.In our ‘Resources’ section  we present tasks geared towards helping you practice  develop  and enhance your English reading  listening  and speaking abilities. We also include helpful tips to guide your writing activities  mainly focusing on the ending and an effective concluding paragraph that leaves a reader with a lasting impression. Enroll for this English course to take a significant step forward towards becoming proficient in this global language.

product_name: Learn English: Hobbies and Past Perfect Continuous Tense
description: Stress and anxiety are part of everyday life  so learning how to manage them is important. This English course is designed to teach you basic stress-related vocabulary and the hobbies and leisure activities you can do to relieve it. We provide the language phrases you need to discuss what you do to relax and relate accounts about your past and current hobbies.After supplying new vocabulary  the course focuses on two grammar areas  beginning with the past perfect continuous tense and its forms. We then compare the past perfect continuous tense with its past continuous counterpart and demonstrate how to use the past continuous tense to discuss old habits. Our second grammar topic teaches you how to use 'used to' and 'would' and compares the use of the two to discuss past habits. We explain how to combine these terms with adverbs of frequency and identify the correct placement of the adverb.The course then integrates your vocabulary and grammar skills by practicing reading  listening  and writing using what you have learned about hobbies  stress management  the past perfect continuous  the past continuous  'used to ' and 'would.' We have included writing tips and exercises in our 'Resources' section to help you practice your skills and gain confidence. Sign up to gain confidence as you engage your newfound vocabulary and grammatical skills to discuss what you do for fun in English.

product_name: Game Development Using Unity 3D and Mapbox
description: This course is a complete guide to developing games in Unity 3D using real-world data from Mapbox  a map service  and API that provides developers with access to detailed location data and allows them to embed styled maps into games. This self-paced course begins with a brief overview of Mapbox  after which you will learn how to set up the game scene  add elements  sounds  and points of interest.Learn how to use filters to improve the map's user interface and performance  as well as how to create a game project and add players to the scene. Discover the best settings for creating Android games  as well as how to dynamically assign map locations  create singletons  and use the game droid factory. Finally  you learn about the platform-dependent compiler  as well as how to create and implement the game manager  improve the UI controller  prepare it for deployment  and load and save player data.Most modern games now include mapping functionality as a standard feature. This course is specially designed for Unity developers who want to take their game development skills to the next level. It includes detailed tutorial videos to help you fully understand how to build games using real-world data. By taking this free course  you can advance your game development career to the next level. Enroll to start now!

product_name: OSHA Fundamentals - Managing Risk of Fire Emergencies
description: Fires present a hazard in nearly all workplaces. They normally occur due to poor implementation of safety regulations and standards - which is in turn often caused by a lack of understanding of occupational health and safety practices. With this in mind  Exoexcellence Consultants have prepared this detailed course on fire protection in occupational settings to help current and aspiring fire safety professionals and managers to protect employees from danger and comply with federal health and safety regulations.The course is divided into two modules  each made up of three base topics. We go through the fire safety requirements laid out by the Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) and explain how to legally implement them to protect workplaces from fire. We show you how to form capable organizational fire brigade teams to protect your workplace in an emergency. We also examine the classification of fires and the equipment used to fight them before demonstrating the first aid methods used to treat burns. This course also establishes the importance of developing and implementing a comprehensive emergency egress plan that guides employees out of the building in the event of fire. We present graphics  pictures  statistical information and two case studies based to help you understand the role of OSHA in protecting employees and equipment. Whether you are already a safety officer or want to add this skill to your portfolio  this occupational health and safety  course provides the training required to protect your workplace from fire hazards and comply with federal OSHA regulations.

Auditing is a regular part of every organisation’s financial processes. Companies conduct these audits for various reasons  starting with the need to enhance efficiency and eliminate wasteful expenditure. However  these audits sometimes fail to produce the desired results and certain skills are required to make them fruitful and justify the expense and effort they demand. With this in mind  the experts at Exoexcellence Consultants have designed this course to help you conduct effective internal audits.The primary aim of this course is to train students who aspire to become professional auditors in the future and to help internal auditing professionals who want to enhance their skills. The course consists of a single module with three topics. The first topic discusses different types of internal audits and compares internal and external audits. Our second topic then takes you through the steps of conducting an internal audit. We cover all the minute details and technical points that define this technical process. The course’s final topic explains how to prepare an internal audit report and present it to the company's management. We employ various graphics to make learning the complex aspects of auditing easier for you and our assessment offers an opportunity for you to practise your newfound skills. Sign up to enhance your accounting and bookkeeping abilities and learn how internal auditing can save an organisation money by identifying waste and preventing fraud.

There are a variety of abilities you must master to succeed as a copywriter. We explain how to develop these crucial skills and show you how to emphasise and showcase them in job applications. We begin with a definition of ‘copywriting’ and lay the foundations on which you can build your persuasive skills in pursuit of excellence.This course breaks down the different areas of copywriting and explains how to write compelling copy that motivates its target audience to act. We move past the basics and explore topics such as style and tone as we demonstrate how to write eye-catching headlines and advertisements. Your copywriting career is more likely to take off if you add online copywriting to your professional portfolio. We teach you how to write copy for publication on mainstream or independent platforms for digital or print media.Copywriting combines hard and soft skills that marketing and advertising writers employ to motivate consumers. Professionals in this field must have exceptional writing and communication skills and this copywriting training course equips you with these skills and insider tips. This course has no prerequisites and is suitable for everyone with a keen interest in copywriting. Sign up to turn your flair for language and persuasion into a rewarding career in the exciting world of marketing and copywriting.

product_name: Teaching English as a Foreign Language (TEFL)
description: English is spoken by over 1.75 billion people as a first or second language and is a global language widely used in many fields  from engineering to art and medicine. The demand for standard English teachers will thus rise as more and more people seek to learn the language. We designed this TEFL course for anyone interested in turning their English skills into a career in this field. We begin with an overview of the fundamentals of TEFL  which include applied linguistics  pronunciation and teaching methodologies.Lesson planning is one of the most important responsibilities facing TEFL teachers and requires that they set long-term goals and learning outcomes for their classes. We provide effective lesson planning and teaching methods to help you choose the right content and deliver it successfully. We show you how to use games and activities to help students learn English and examine the role of information technology in teaching grammar and vocabulary in classrooms and online. TEFL requires more than English skills and we provide the pedagogic training you need to teach  including classroom and time management and the steps taken to motivate students.This course provides the abilities required to help others with early language acquisition as they navigate a new linguistic culture. These abilities can be honed through practice exercises found in our ‘Resources’ section. Finally  we discuss employment opportunities available for TEFL teachers and explain how to advance your career teaching English as a second language. Many people use their TEFL training to finance travel abroad or to generate extra income. Sign up for this course to turn your English skills into a career as a TEFL teacher.

A smartphone with a good camera is a wonderful way to take photographs as it presents countless opportunities to capture unplanned moments and sights as you’re likely to carry it wherever you go. Mobile phones can take iconic pictures if you know how to use them but smartphone photography presents its own challenges. This mobile phone photography course takes you through the essentials of photography and identifies the necessary equipment. We then compare smartphones and digital cameras and lay out the benefits and drawbacks of taking photographs with a phone.The course then establishes the importance of lighting in all types of photography. Even if you have no idea how to use the many shooting modes on a smartphone  this course teaches you everything you need to know to make the most of your phone’s camera. We help you develop your ‘eye’ and photographic skills as you capture the world around you. We also demonstrate how to get the best possible shot with your smartphone by tweaking your camera's settings in different situations and environments.The course compares various add-on lenses available for smartphones and highlights the effects of each on your photos. All photographers need tips to improve and we cover a wide range of techniques to help you polish your photographic and editing skills. Finally  we show you how to make the most of Instagram as you seek to turn your work into content and online engagement. This mobile photography course is designed to help you harness your creativity and create memorable images of the world around you as you go about your day.

Exposure to loud noise for long periods of time causes permanent hearing loss. This health and safety course explains how to control workplace noise and prevent hearing loss. We identify the sources of noise and discuss how to implement the ‘hierarchy of noise control’  from elimination and substitution to engineering control and implementing administrative measures. We show you how noise can severely affect people’s health and wellbeing.The course lays out the factors affecting noise risk and symptoms of hearing loss. We identify acceptable noise levels and the most common causes of hearing loss in adults. We explain the concept of ‘safe hearing’ and which sound levels or decibels (dB) require hearing protection and how long you can listen to various decibels. We then assess the effectiveness of hearing protectors and delve into the UK legislation designed to eliminate noise risk and protect employees in the workplace.Finally  we lay out the roles of your organisation’s health and safety executive and demonstrate how to set up an action plan for mitigating noise hazards. We discuss various hearing conservation programmes and the use of personal audiometric records. This comprehensive training course provides in-demand skills to help you further your career and improve your professional skills. This course suits managers responsible for the health and safety of their colleagues or anyone concerned about their noisy work environment. Sign up to learn how to protect your hearing.

This course on sexual harassment is ideal for anyone looking to learn what constitutes this form of abuse to improve their workplace culture. We begin by exploring the classifications of sexual harassment and its various forms. We study the difference between 'quid pro quo' arrangements and harassment that results in a 'hostile environment' at work. We then go through the various myths surrounding this subject  from the clothes you wear to the role of alcohol  and compare facts to fiction.When it comes to sexual harassment  it is important that you know your rights and those of the people around you. This human resources training course lays out the guidelines for handling sexual abuse but is designed to benefit anyone who works around people. We explain what to do if you witness harassment and establish the importance of being an ‘active bystander’. We trace the legal routes to follow in such situations and examine various workplace policies put in place to protect the safety and dignity of all employees. We discuss how to avoid being implicated in any form of harassment or sexual assault and provide steps you can take to stop it from happening to you.In the course’s final section  we study sexual harassment in more detail and focus on preventing it in the workplace. This section delves deeper into the many types of sexual harassment and explains how to gather evidence  respond to allegations and protect your employees if you are in a managerial position. We explain what goes into a work policy governing this kind of behaviour before demonstrating how to introduce such a policy to your staff as you put preventative measures in place. This important course is ideal for anyone who wants to learn more about workplace sexual harassment to play a constructive role in preventing it from happening to themselves or their colleagues. Such knowledge can also keep you out of legal and professional trouble so sign up for this training course to learn where the boundaries are and how to stay on the right side of them.

product_name: How to Be an Ethical Whistleblower
description: This corporate ethics course is designed to help you cultivate an organisational culture that promotes responsible  ethical behaviour. This requires effective communication when it comes to reporting wrongdoings and this course explains how whistleblowing can help you and your organisation achieve greater credibility in a world where transparency and social responsibility are considered important. We begin with a definition of ‘whistleblowing’ and lay out its different types. We then examine certain barriers that can prevent individuals from coming forward and reporting misconduct.The course delves into the legal aspects of whistleblowing in depth and examines key legislation passed over the years. We explain when the law supports individuals who report corrupt practices and when it doesn’t. We also analyse the cultural and legal implications within organisations to show you how to ensure openness of communication with the relevant authorities. All organisations require a formal whistleblowing programme designed to encourage individuals to step forward and communicate any wrongdoings they encounter within the company. We demonstrate how to set up and implement such programmes to ensure their success in creating ethical corporate governance.Every whistleblowing investigation carries its fair share of inherent risk. We explore these risks and explain how organisations can mitigate them. A systematic approach towards investigations and well-publicised formal procedures can protect both individuals and their organisation when it comes to reporting misconduct. We go through these practices in detail to provide a thorough understanding of the process. With today’s emphasis on social responsibility and ethical business practices  whistleblowing can play a crucial role in helping individuals and organisations maintain their credibility and achieve their goals. This business ethics course can help managers receive the information required to run a clean office. It also suits anyone who wants to report corporate wrongdoing and seeks legal protection.

Veterinary medicine is the subspecialty of medicine that focuses on the diagnosis  prevention  management and treatment of illness and injury in animals. Veterinary medicine that focuses on disease is known as ‘veterinary epidemiology’. We begin this diploma course by explaining how to make a diagnosis by conducting a physical examination of the affected animal. We also examine methods used to maintain biosecurity and control infection  including practical antimicrobial therapeutics used to kill harmful microorganisms. This course shows you how to diagnose an animal during an emergency and identifies when to hospitalise the patient. We demonstrate the importance of identifying the targeted therapy and detecting signs of nervousness and anxiety. The course lays out the symptoms and treatment of diseases of the liver and pancreas  including diseases of the alimentary tract. We then move on to diseases of the heart and circulatory system and provide clinical treatment procedures. Finally  we explain how decisions are made in veterinary emergency medicine. This diploma course provides the tools you need to comprehend the principles of veterinary medicine. You can use this knowledge to better understand animals and their needs. We describe the everyday life of a veterinarian and provide you with an understanding of what the job requires  from treating emergencies to dealing with clinical procedures. Sign up to earn a diploma that signals your aptitude and ability to provide healthcare to sick and injured animals.

product_name: Autism Spectrum Disorder in Early Childhood
description: In this course  you explore the characteristics of autism spectrum disorder (ASD) and its effects on young children. Following that  we discuss the differences between children with autism and those with normal development. We then explore the epidemiology of ASD and the different diagnostic criteria for spectrum disorders. Learning how to deal with the critical sensory problems children experience with autism disorder is discussed in detail. Next  learn about the body and object use skills of children with ASD compared to normal development.The course explains various education methods for children with autism using different strategies. Study educational programs related to the behaviour modification model and discuss basic learning readiness skills for children's development. How to teach autistic children to speak in order to develop their vocabulary is also covered. Then  learn about the behaviour problems in autistic children that cause them difficulty. Following this  explore some models  methods  and theories that benefit preschoolers with autism. Next  examine symptoms of gastrointestinal problems in autism spectrum disorder. Children with ASD also face a lot of nutritional problems and we will discuss how to deal with these through a proper diet plan.Then  we will explore nutritional behaviour associated with the disorder and deficiencies in micronutrients  such as calcium  magnesium  and B12. In addition  we will discuss how heavy metals aid stress reduction in autistic children. Then explore benefits of the Mediterranean diet as well as gluten-free (or casein-free)  low-carb and ketogenic diets  and see how to do an elimination diet for allergies to certain foods. This course is ideal for parents  special education teachers or preschool educators to develop their knowledge of ASD in early childhood.

Counselling received in schools is one of the most common forms of psychotherapy available to children and young adults. Every child and adolescent experiences their own set of distinct developmental changes and may feel uncertain or even overwhelmed by those changes. Counselling helps them to understand themselves and the challenges they face better and teaches them how to manage these challenges. This training course provides a solid understanding of the theoretical aspects of school counselling.We compare counselling and psychotherapy and explain why the British Association for Counselling changed their name in 2000 to include psychotherapy. We also provide various counselling methods and demonstrate how to establish a therapeutic rapport with your clients. The course then delves into school counselling and the working practices peculiar to educational environments. We describe the personal qualities required of a school counsellor if they hope to fulfil their duties and responsibilities effectively.The course explains how to communicate with children of different ages and developmental levels. It is important to remember that children and adolescents spend more time at home than in the therapy room. We provide case studies to help you learn how to conduct a family counselling session with parents  who may be separated or divorced. We then show you how to conduct an online counselling session and help children with psychological problems and disorders. Sign up for this course to train as a school counsellor capable of guiding children and teenagers through troubled times as you seek to improve their mental health and wellbeing.

product_name: Building a Professional Brand Using LinkedIn - 2022
description: Many LinkedIn users are not actively looking for work or to connect with others. Branding oneself and one's business is an integral part of using LinkedIn to its full potential. Just as in every other aspect of life  what we share  write and engage with on LinkedIn defines our personal and professional brands. This digital marketing course is designed to teach you how to establish and maintain a positive professional image on LinkedIn while monitoring your brand's performance.We explore the LinkedIn platform and explain why social engagement is considered the ‘magic sauce’ of using LinkedIn as a business tool. We then examine some professional branding philosophies that you can employ on LinkedIn or any other social media platform to create the best brand for your business and career. One of the most common errors people make is to ignore their profile completely so we teach you how to build a LinkedIn profile that speaks directly to your target audience using far-reaching keywords and phrases.The course then shows you how to develop your brand through networking and sharing content on LinkedIn. We demonstrate how to use LinkedIn's messaging  groups and pages to promote your brand. We then explain how to measure the growth of your brand on LinkedIn and how to make the most of the platform’s ‘Creator’ mode. Business coach and LinkedIn expert Teddy Burriss is your instructor for this course and he has a wealth of experience in running training and coaching programmes for business people who want to learn how to make the most of LinkedIn. LinkedIn is a powerful  global platform that has made many careers. Sign up to harness LinkedIn’s ability to build and boost your professional brand and it can do the same for yours.

In the healthcare industry  qualified medical secretaries are in high demand and play an important role. This administration training course is perfect for both experienced medical secretaries and newcomers to the field since it provides the theoretical basis and practical knowledge you require to do the job successfully. We identify the basic responsibilities of the role and describe what to expect from the work environment.The course then outlines the process of organising and managing appointments and schedules. Since a medical secretary's duties are primarily administrative in nature  we cover the maintenance of medical records  proper filing procedures and the importance of confidentiality in the medical environment. We delve into general office administration techniques like managing deliveries  supplies and inventory before laying out common medical jargon terms you will encounter as a medical secretary.The course then explains the important role of workplace health and safety in medical settings. It is important that you protect yourself with knowledge of first aid  disease control and fire prevention. We conclude with an overview of the role of information technology and computers in the healthcare industry as you must respect the privacy and dignity of patients. If you are considering a career as an administrator in the healthcare industry  this medical secretary training course is for you.

product_name: Introduction to Criminology and the UK Justice System
description: Do you want to understand what motivates people to commit crimes? Does the criminal justice system fascinate you? This criminology course goes through the professional and legal approaches taken to prevent and solve crimes. We begin with an overview of the major elements that define criminology and describe major legal systems found around the world. We investigate the root causes of crime and lay out the five-step process used to profile criminals.The course then examines the classification of crimes. We outline how the police investigate violent crimes and domestic abuse and show you how they process  reconstruct and link crime scenes. We then study the tactics used to interview suspects  victims and eyewitnesses and identify the key factors that affect witness performance. The course delves into criminal psychology as one of the focal points of criminology as we research the criminal process and the mindsets that motivate criminal activity.Forensic evidence plays a major role in crime-solving so we explain how toxicology  ballistics  anthropometry and DNA profiling work. We demonstrate how to examine and classify evidence  investigate offender signatures and generate a criminal profile. We also establish the importance of science  critical thinking  logic and metacognition in criminal profiling. This course suits anyone who wants to build a career in criminology  criminal justice  law enforcement  public safety and legal studies. Sign up to understand what motivates criminals and the processes employed to catch and prosecute them.

Would you like to develop your written and spoken English vocabulary to further your healthcare career? This course is designed to help you improve your understanding of English and develop your communication skills as a healthcare provider. Our video lessons present commonly used medical jargon and specialised vocabulary used by English-speaking healthcare professionals.The course begins with an overview of the human body as we explain English anatomical terms with illustrations. We then analyse the components of the skull  the eyes and the ear before laying out the components of the vertebral column and thoracic cage (rib cage). We also go over the English terms used to describe many scientific instruments used by healthcare professionals. The course provides a list of medical terms used to discuss frequently performed laboratory tests and diagnostic techniques. We show you how to use English to describe organ systems like the digestive  cardiovascular  immune and respiratory systems. Finally  we study the professional skills required to communicate effectively with your clients and colleagues. This course helps you to master the English vocabulary used by healthcare practitioners in medical settings. This will open up new career opportunities and enhance your ability to understand patients in emergency situations where effective communication might make the difference between life and death.

Everyone wants to live a healthy life. This often requires access to instant medical intervention so individuals and groups must make concrete plans to achieve their health goals. This course introduces you to the care planning process using a learner-centred approach. We study care plan policies based on government guidelines and models of social care delivery in the UK. We highlight the roles of the multidisciplinary team drawing up and implementing care plans and establish the importance of the 'concept care map'.The course then highlights the best approaches to effective care plan implementation. Learn how to evaluate a care plan considering parameters like self-management  team management and more. We discuss ways to maintain  retain and dispose of medical records. In addition  we review the UK's care planning policy and the role of the World Health Organization (WHO) in health and social planning in Europe.We emphasise why you must safeguard children and young people by keeping them away from crime  antisocial behaviour and educational failure. The course examines various forms of child abuse and neglect and explains how to identify victims and seek help for them. Lastly  we examine government policies for safeguarding vulnerable children. Enrol in this course today to learn the details of care planning policies and enhance your ability to provide effective patient care.

product_name: Fly Drones Like a Pro – Beginner to Intermediate
description: Drones make a powerful impact on many people’s everyday lives as they perform important tasks from delivering online purchases to providing crucial medicine and defibrillators in rural areas. We see them flying on the beach  in parks and around the city - but what is the right way to fly them? Is it easy or hard? Everyone can learn to fly a drone and this course provides the skills required to do so safely and legally while still having fun.We begin by establishing the importance of flying drones safely. We identify the many contemporary uses of drones and investigate ways in which they can improve our lives in the future. The course then discusses the technical aspects of drones and examines their important components. We explain their inner workings and what to do if something goes wrong to help you avoid the mistakes commonly made by beginner drone pilots.This course is designed to prepare you for the experience of flying a drone. Drones are here to stay and unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) technology will develop as time progresses. You may even have thought of an innovative new use of drones yourself! Sign up to learn how to maintain and fly a drone and add a valuable new skill to your professional portfolio.

The primary purpose of business is to make money from customers who pay for its products or services. The growth and success of a business brand are therefore closely linked to how much its customers appreciate it  which manifests as ‘brand loyalty’. This marketing course explains how to build a brand that appeals to your target audience. We provide proven techniques and expert insider tips to help you accomplish your branding and marketing goals and establish a loyal customer base.This course begins with the process of finding an ideal name that suits your brand.
