We compare literal  metaphoric and fanciful names and discuss how the nature of your business should guide you when choosing a brand name that appeals to potential customers. The course explains how to establish a solid brand identity that will stir up the emotions of your target audience and keep them loyally connected to your brand.The course describes the qualities your brand message should possess to suit your potential customers' values. We establish the importance of developing creative guidelines for your brand as they allow you to build a brand character that appeals to your potential customers and persuades them to choose your goods and services over the competition. Sign up for this marketing course to learn the principles of branding and employ proven marketing techniques to connect with and retain a loyal customer base.

product_name: Comprehensive Guide to Construction Design and Management
description: Construction design and management (CDM) is a set of health and safety guidelines applicable to all construction projects in the United Kingdom. This course teaches you the basics  origin and history of CDM regulations and explains how these regulations were altered to meet the requirements of the construction industry. CDM assigns certain roles and responsibilities to those involved in a construction project and we show you how each stakeholder promotes health and safety on a construction site. We then compare the responsibilities of clients and those of the construction company’s employees. Just like any management system  the field of construction health and safety requires certain documents. We identify the necessary CDM documents and outline who is responsible for maintaining them and how they should do so.A construction project can be divided into multiple stages with each stage requiring its own flow of information to communicate health and safety risks. This course identifies the information required at every step of a project and the personnel responsible for obtaining and sharing it. The ‘health and safety file' is a record document that must be revised from time to time and shared with the relevant people on a construction site. We explore the key contents of a ‘health and safety file’ and identify commercially available software products that support specific CDM standards or guidelines before demonstrating how they can be tailored to your needs. The course then covers health and safety rules  traffic regulations  emergency procedures and how to prevent accidents from occurring on construction sites.We designed this course for people who work or intend to work in the field of construction safety. This course is also useful for learners who studied occupational health and safety and now want to specialise in this field. This course also suits anyone considering a construction project who wants to meet their legal and safety obligations as clients. It covers the relevant legal guidelines governing construction design and management (CDM) in the UK. The instructor provides a case study related to site safety to provide a practical understanding of construction safety concepts. All construction organisations need to hire construction safety professionals to create and apply cost-effective safety protocols and meet their legal requirements. Career opportunities are thus available for people trained in CDM practices who possess expertise in construction safety. Sign up to build and improve your knowledge of construction design and management and learn how to maintain safety on building sites and meet your legal obligations.

Receptionists are key members of their organisations and ensure smooth office operations. This administration course comprehensively explains the various skills and career progressions of a receptionist. We begin by introducing you to the basic concepts important to those who work in reception. We examine the different types of receptionist and compare their roles. Top-tier receptionists are expected to communicate effectively because they are the first point of contact with customers  both face-to-face and over the phone  and they play an important role in making a good first impression. We provide effective communication skills and discuss good telephone etiquette. We distinguish between formal and informal messages and emphasise the importance of confidentiality when taking and sending messages. Receptionists are privy to a lot of sensitive information and need to be discreet and skilled in managing it. We outline the basics of database management and show you how to ensure confidentiality with data.As a receptionist  you may be required to make a variety of bookings or reservations. We provide effective scheduling techniques to help you manage reservations and other routine administrative tasks. The course compares the duties of a receptionist and those of a secretary. We then study filing systems to help you master the important task of managing them. Occupational health and safety is crucial to many industries and we explain how to prevent workplace accidents and protect your colleagues from risk. The course then provides the techniques required to make meetings successful  from arranging accommodation for attendees to record-keeping and writing minutes. Your grasp on organisational skills like time management will ensure that your office runs smoothly and efficiently.The course examines the use of information technology in administrative work and identifies the software packages that are useful to a receptionist. We explore the concept of teamwork and relate it to the role of a receptionist who is a good team player. The reception area of an office in any industry plays a key role in making a first impression and must appear welcoming and professional to visitors. We therefore show you how to make yours more appealing and impressive to customers. A receptionist job keeps you busy and serves as a perfect springboard to further career progression. This course has no prerequisites and is intended for anyone who wants to be a receptionist. It also suits current administrators who want to improve their skills. Sign up to turn your talent for organisation and working with people into a rewarding career.

product_name: Intermediate Chemistry: Nitrogen  Transition Elements and Metal Complexes
description: The most prevalent element in group 15 of the periodic table  nitrogen  is the first element covered in this intermediate chemistry course. You learn about the nitrogen component  nitrogen gas  and its properties  as well as how ammonia is made in industry using the Haber-Bosch method and in the laboratory from ammonium chloride and magnesium nitride. You then discover the applications of ammonia and related compounds  including the creation of TNT explosives and fertilizers. Then we look into sulfur's physical properties  the contact method used to make sulfuric acid  and its industrial uses.Next  the course moves on to transition elements  which occupy groups between two and 13 on the periodic table (starting from period 4) and are used in many aspects of life and industry. Some examples of transition elements are iron  copper and titanium. You study their electronic configurations and properties  like high melting points  densities and hardness. We also investigate the redox reactions of iron compounds and the titration process  as well as the formation of coordination bonds and aqueous complexes that result from the dissolving of salts of transition elements in water.As the course progresses  we discuss the stereoisomerism of transition element complexes including geometrical isomers like cis and trans-platin and optical isomers that can rotate the plane of polarised light. You learn to determine whether a complex has geometrical and optical isomers (non-superimposable isomers). Finally  we explore the substitution of ligands with hydroxyl ions  ammonia  or halogen ions to form new complexes  more stable than aqueous ones  with different structures and colors. The final topic covered is the colors of period four transition element complexes and how they arise from the split of 3D orbitals into non-degenerate orbitals. Why wait? Register for this simple-to-understand chemistry course right away.

Asbestos is a naturally occurring fibrous silicate mineral. This course will hone your asbestos-working compliance skills and the required precautions to reduce exposure hazards. We start by looking at the definition and sources of asbestos with how it impacts human health before delving into its main types in the UK  including how to identify it in vehicles  equipment and buildings. Study the concept of asbestos-containing material (ACM) including the difference between ‘pure’ asbestos and ACMs.Familiarise yourself with the common types of asbestos materials and the conditions under which various ACMs will release fibres to avoid the risk of exposure. We lay out several materials that are viable alternatives to asbestos. Look deeper into the reasons for and timing of the asbestos ban in UK buildings with why the issue persists today. We discuss the benefits and compensation for asbestos-related diseases and the legislation that aims to protect people in the workplace.Finally  we cover the types of asbestos licensing like licensable work and non-licensable work. Learn how to manage asbestos in non-domestic premises and assess the risk in the workplace. We outline the precautions to follow when working with asbestos and the appropriate use of respiratory protective equipment. We will break down the procedures for handling asbestos-containing waste (ACW) disposal  accidental disturbance of ACMs and dealing with emergencies. This course is suitable for those in the construction sector with no prior qualifications or experience required. Enrol and start learning today - for free.

product_name: Nursing Care for Patients With Learning Disabilities
description: This course illustrates the different roles of learning disability nurses. It starts by defining learning disabilities and mental health as two distinct fields and then discusses the mental health needs of people with learning disabilities. Then  study learning disability nursing in general  including its history  development and social policy changes that have impacted the role of learning disability nursing. We also explain therapeutic nursing  and developing partnership  intimacy and reciprocity in the nurse-patient relationship.The next section explains various psychosocial approaches that can help people with learning disabilities and mental illness. You will study the fundamentals and application of cognitive behavioural therapy (CBT)  anger management  behaviour therapy  systematic desensitisation  relaxation training  modelling  social skills training and counselling. Following that  you look at the psychodynamic approaches that focus on psychoanalysis. Next  we highlight psychodynamic therapy  the therapist-client relationship and non-specific therapy factors. The knowledge and practical skills nurses need when working with people with learning disabilities across their lifespans is discussed.You will also comprehend the role of learning disability nurses in helping people with learning disabilities plan for good health and well-being. In addition  you discover the pertinent issues associated with planning and delivering care for people with intellectual disabilities who have mental health problems. We will also explain different nursing models and behavioural interventions. The final section discusses the future of learning disability nursing within the ever-changing health and social care context. So  sign up for this free course to discover the nursing care process for dually diagnosed people. Optional certification available.

Research indicates that motivational interviewing (MI) is as good as or better than cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) and pharmacotherapy  as well as superior to non-treatment controls for reducing alcohol and drug use in individuals. This course is designed to teach therapists and practitioners the fundamentals of motivational interviewing  a client-centered approach to psychotherapy pioneered by Stephen Rollnick and William R. Miller. We begin by covering the fundamentals of MI  such as its principles  approaches  and history.MI practice necessitates the skillful application of a variety of strategies and techniques  one of which is OARS (open-ended questions  affirming  reflective listening  and summarizing)  a quick and easy way to remember the basic approach used in MI. You will learn how to encourage behavioral change in patients by assisting them in exploring and resolving their ambivalence about the change. You will also learn about stages of change and the possibilities of group-based MI. Finally  you study motivational interviewing theories and MI in various health settings as well as how to develop and maintain your MI skills.This course focuses on using MI to assist therapists and practitioners in developing rapport with patients in the early stages of counseling relationships. The knowledge gained will assist therapists in dealing with one of the most difficult but rewarding challenges: helping people change long-standing habits that pose significant health risks. Take this course today and advance your career in motivational therapy.

Chemistry touches everything we do because everything in existence can be broken down into chemical building blocks - even the existence of Earth itself. This course begins with the history of chemistry and how it relates to other scientific disciplines. The divisions of chemistry and how it is used in daily life is covered after that. Chemical reactions are responsible for many of the changes we see in the environment. Understanding the makeup of chemicals and their reactions can help us understand a range of physical and biological phenomena. Learn more about chemical bonding and equilibrium  including its traits  influences and related examples.See how chemical elements are grouped in the periodic table according to their recurring properties and how the elements are arranged according to an electron configuration pattern. We will also teach you how to use the periodic table to identify the properties of all the elements  including those that haven't yet been discovered. The periodic table is a fantastic resource for problem-solving. We will also teach you about chemistry and electricity: learn how redox reactions and other electrical sources work to conduct electricity. Studying chemical reactions at the molecular level with biochemistry helps you comprehend the universe and create new applications for them. See how components of biochemistry have been used to create many initiatives for human welfare.The term ‘nuclear’ has mainly been used in bad light because of nuclear weapons and reactor explosions  yet nuclear science has many benefits. Numerous diagnostic and therapeutic techniques employ nuclear medicine. You will learn more about nuclear chemistry in this course  including radioactive elements and how the medical field uses them. We will also look at environmental and industrial chemistry. To protect laboratory employees from injury caused by dangerous chemicals  you examine the lab safety and chemical hygiene strategy. Chemistry is important because it provides a solid foundation for comprehending the physical universe that we inhabit. This course's primary objective is to give you this knowledge and ensure that you are aware of how crucial chemistry is to our daily life. Anyone interested in learning the fundamentals of chemistry can enroll in this course; no prior expertise is necessary.

product_name: Basics of AutoCAD  SolidWorks and T-Flex
description: Since its inception  computer-aided design (CAD) has grown in popularity and relevance due to its widespread adoption by top manufacturing industries such as civil engineering to design and execute projects. This course has been created to teach you the features and applications of various software used in CAD. It begins with an overview of the history and significance of CAD  as well as the skills  requirements  and roles of a CAD designer. Learn about product design  cost estimations  and considerations for using CAD  as well as solid and fluid mechanisms terms and laws.The idea behind 3D drawings is to add a third dimension to designs to show depth all in one view. By taking this course  you will also learn about 2D drawings  the Z coordinate  geometry  and modeling in CAD. Discover the concepts of assemblies and mechatronic simulations in CAD  as well as extrusion and rotation. We will teach you about grids  regular polygons  and blending operations in CAD. Learn the properties of various parameters in civil drawings such as walls and columns  and then the features and applications of AutoCAD  T-FLEX  FreeCAD  and SolidWorks in computer-aided design.The value of CAD cannot be overstated  from preliminary design and layouts to design details  calculations  and 3D modeling. The demand for these jobs will only increase as technology advances. This course was created to serve as a free online guide for anyone interested in becoming a CAD designer. Upskill by enrolling today!

product_name: Emergency Protocol for an Active Shooter
description: This course on active shooting prepares you for the possibility of encountering an active shooter at work or educational environment. We begin by defining ‘active shooter’ and provide some statistics on the rise of mass shootings over the last few years. We then provide survival techniques by explaining the three essential actions (run  hide or fight) and other vital guidelines.The second section of the course focuses on specific scenarios relevant to places likely to be targeted  including colleges and healthcare facilities. We analyse some basic preparation techniques and outline when or if you should assist others in escaping. We show you how to answer the questions law enforcement officers will ask when you call them during an active shooting scenario and explain their primary and secondary goals.  The course's final section touches on possible indications and habits that may alert you if someone is on the verge of committing widespread violence. We establish the importance of an emergency action plan (EAP) in equipping your personnel with the skills required to react appropriately and lessen the chance of fatalities. Finally  we study the role of managers during active shooter situations and demonstrate how to conduct a post-incident assessment once the situation is under control. Sign up for this health and safety training course to pick up valuable skills that might prevent mass shootings and save lives.

product_name: Psychology of Anxiety and Stress Management
description: Do you know that an estimated 275 million people suffer from anxiety disorders? This represents about 4% of the global population as people face situations that  if not handled properly  can lead to chronic stress and clinical anxiety in the long run. This psychology course teaches you how to manage stress and anxiety and examines various treatments used by professional psychologists to improve their patients’ mental health.We begin with simple definitions of ‘stress’ and an examination of its primary causes. We explain that stress is not always harmful to the body and can actually improve your life. The course then lays out the major risk factors associated with stress. A ‘normal’ level of stress can be managed by employing some simple stress management techniques. We study such techniques with the help of various real-life scenarios and practical examples to provide a practical understanding of the psychology behind stress.Exercise is essential for maintaining one's physical health but also plays a role in improving our mental health. The course establishes the role of exercise in managing stress and anxiety disorders. We then discuss psychiatric options like drugs and clinical treatments that professionals use to treat severe stress and anxiety. This course suits anyone who is concerned about the impact of stress and anxiety and is interested in using mindfulness techniques to improve their mental health. It also suits professional psychologists and psychiatrists who want to stay current on the most advanced treatment techniques.

About one in ten people in the U.S. live with diabetes  many of whom do not even know they have it. In this free online diabetes awareness course  we explain how diabetes affects the health of the human body. We discuss various risk factors and explain how changes to lifestyle habits can help manage the disease before examining the role of clinical diabetes treatments. The course begins with the scientific definition of ‘diabetes’. We then trace the health effects of diabetes  including its psychological impact on mental health.Women and men experience the symptoms of diabetes differently. We compare the disease’s effect on each sex and contrast the methods used to manage and treat it. Adopting healthy dietary and daily habits can prevent lifestyle diseases like diabetes. We demonstrate that even small lifestyle changes  like regular exercise and healthy eating  can play a key role in preventing diabetes. The course also delves into the social care cost of treating diabetes in the United Kingdom.Diabetes is divided into two categories: type 1 and type 2. We go over the signs and symptoms of each and show you how to identify their risk factors. The timely treatment of any disease is critical and should be prioritised so we provide the various treatments used to stay ahead of this disease. Finally  the course discusses some rare and genetic types of diabetes  including gestational diabetes  hypoglycaemia and Wolfram syndrome. This course is designed to help healthcare professionals manage and treat diabetes but also suits anyone who wants to keep themselves and their loved ones safe. Sign up to learn what simple lifestyle changes can prevent diabetes from affecting your life.

product_name: Basics of Animal Care and Psychology
description: There are about seven million species of animals in the world. Each species has a different set of care needs. This animal psychology course lays out the guidelines used to provide proper care to common pets and animals that protects their physical and mental health. This course is carefully curated by a team of experienced professionals from the Study Hub. Study Hub is a leading education provider and believes in promoting student-driven teaching and learning that encompasses engagement and practice.The course begins with a definition of ‘animal welfare’. We show you that ‘welfare’ does not just include food but also encompasses psychological wellbeing  hygiene  proper nutrition and the animal’s environment. We also discuss the origins and domestic histories of various common animals that live in our homes and farms. We use real-world examples to demonstrate how veterinary professionals use various behavioural  physical and physiological indicators to assess an animal’s health. The course explains how to monitor such indicators to keep track of the physical and mental health of animals in your care.We then teach you various first-aid techniques used to treat animals in emergency situations. The course focuses on common pets like cats  dogs  horses and birds to prepare you for dangerous domestic situations. We then teach you how to provide animal care to rabbits  guinea pigs  reptiles and ornamental fish. This course has no prerequisites and provides the knowledge and skills needed to assess your pet's health and care for it. It also suits anyone interested in a career related to animal care. Sign up to ensure the health and wellbeing of animals in your care.

Are you a nurse and want to learn how to write prescriptions as part of your responsibilities? This course from Skill Up lays out the basics of prescribing medications for nurses. We begin by discussing the important legislation that permits nurses to prescribe medicines. We then explore medicine management  clinical pharmacokinetics and drug interactions. We also discuss adult anxiety disorders and demonstrate how to diagnose and treat them.The course explains how the healthcare industry differentiate between ‘acute’ and ‘chronic’ liver diseases  their causes and medicinal treatments. We then investigate common microbial conditions  cardiac problems and treatments for heart failure. We then move on to medications that can be used to treat neurological problems in patients of any age. We examine ‘palliative care’  which is an extensive area of medicine that covers healthcare provided to vulnerable people like pregnant women  the elderly and children. Finally  the course explores the role nurses play in modern medicine and focuses on their ability to legally write prescriptions. Though there are some barriers to overcome as you acquire the necessary training  nurses can reach their full potential in the healthcare industry by learning how to prescribe medication. Sign up for this course to take your nursing career to the next level as you receive the training required to legally write prescriptions.

Do you have a passion for teaching and want to inspire young minds to ensure that every child has a chance to reach their full potential? This primary education training course is brought to you by Skill Up and is designed to help anyone interested in a career teaching primary school pupils. It is based on the UK's educational system  which is widely recognised as ‘world-class’. We begin by examining the important teaching responsibilities  professional development and career opportunities facing those about to enter the UK’s education system.The course then focuses on the different types of schools that exist in the UK. We lay out their different processes and examine their admission criteria and standards in implementing the national curriculum. We then discuss how the ‘Early Years Foundation Stage’ (EYFS) framework sets out to help children achieve their full potential by setting learning outcomes laid out in the 'Every Child Matters Framework'. The course then provides teaching strategies designed to enhance your pupils’ abilities in terms of English  mathematics and primary science. We discuss how the national curriculum organises Science into four key areas  including the nature of scientific processes and methods of scientific enquiry. We then go through the laws that concern the teaching of children with Special Education Needs (SEN). This course suits anyone who loves to work with young children and wants to play a positive role in their development. Sign up to acquire the classroom skills you need to leave a lasting impression on young minds.

product_name: How to Set Up a Home Business
description: If you hope to launch and maintain a successful company in your home  you require a strong understanding of the fundamentals of running a profitable home business. This basic business course is designed to help you learn everything about running an enterprise from home as quickly as possible. We provide the principles of earning money at home and introduce you to the basics of business management  the factors affecting production and the various forms of business ownership.The course then delves into the principles and practices of entrepreneurship and lays out the pros and cons of home-based businesses. We then show you how to maintain a constructive online presence while working at home. We provide tips on starting your online business from scratch before introducing you to digital marketing. We then examine two eCommerce business models you can employ: dropshipping and affiliate marketing. The course also explains how to take advantage of other home-based job opportunities  including medical jobs  online tutoring  daycare and so on.We highlight the requirements for setting up various professional services you can provide from home. To conclude  the course weighs up the advantages and disadvantages of freelancing. Training Express specialise in accredited certification and training for UK businesses looking to improve organisational performance. They have designed this course to help you improve your chances for success as you launch a business from home. Sign up to gain the entrepreneurial skills you need to be your own boss and seize the opportunities created by your talent and ideas.

Inattention  hyperactivity  and impulsivity are the three primary symptoms of attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder  which is a chronic mental disorder. We begin this course by studying definitions and concepts related to the history of ADHD and its sub-types. We also describe the secondary problems found in ADHD children and outline the benefits of treatment. We will help you answer questions like  What are some symptoms of ADHD? and What is a nonpharmacologic treatment for ADHD?.We explore the symptoms and diagnosis of ADHD  including deficiencies in participation level. We then describe how parents’ level of knowledge of ADHD in their children can affect treatment  including the relationship between family functionality and ADHD. Common eating disorders (ED) in ADHD children are discussed. Finally  this course answers further questions like  What are some symptoms of ADHD? or What psychological support do you need to treat or cope with ADHD?.This course provides you with the fundamental knowledge and basic skills essential to comprehending the effect of ADHD on the growth of children. We describe the everyday life of a child with ADHD and provide techniques to understand related ED. Sign up today if you want to better understand ADHD in early childhood development.

product_name: Child Development: The First Six Years of Physical Development
description: Our developmental periods  which start with fertilization and continue until the end of life  each has its own characteristics. We begin this course by studying the characteristics of developmental periods of early childhood  including the biological and environmental factors that can affect development. This course will help you answer questions like  What is language development? or What are child-related factors? in early childhood development (ECD).We also look at the effects of heredity and environment on development  as well as the importance of reaching physical milestones. We then describe indicators that physical development is proceeding normally  including the nervous and endocrine systems and bodily organs. You will have the answer to questions like  What are the environmental factors that can impact my child? or What are some educational institutions that can assist children with improving their gross and fine motor skills?The course provides the tools you need to comprehend the first six years of a child's physical development. You can confidently apply these practical techniques and important concepts to understanding the critical period from birth to age six. We describe the everyday life of an infant and the many changes that they will experience throughout their physical development. Sign up if you want to learn about these ideas and techniques for understanding the first six years of a child's physical development.

product_name: Learn English: Politics and Comparative Forms
description: This English course provides the necessary vocabulary for discussing politics and elections in this global language. We show you how to read and pronounce these new terms while explaining them using images and definitions. We present a reading activity that places your newfound words and phrases in context. This will help you understand how to use them in conversations as you practice your English skills. The grammar section of this course identifies the three degrees of comparison when we use adjectives and adverbs to compare people and things. We explain the rules that govern the three degrees  including irregular adjectives and adverbs  and explore how to make comparisons using 'the ' 'than ' and 'as.' We illustrate how to intensify specific comparisons using qualifiers  modal verbs  and superlatives (absolute or extreme adjectives like 'best' or 'amazing'). The course also teaches you how to intensify comparisons further using repeated or double comparatives and multiple superlatives. In addition  we have organized activities to help you develop your reading  listening  speaking  and writing skills using what you have learned. The course outlines the format of four essay types and provides techniques used to conform with their conventions and purposes. We provide guidelines and examples in our 'Resources' section to help you write better essays. Learning English can offer many professional opportunities and enriches your ability to communicate worldwide  so sign up to improve your English skills.

This course is an excellent place to start if you want to be a Scrum master  are adopting Scrum in your workplace  or simply want to be a more agile team. It is built on the best learning objectives of the Scrum Alliance and Scrum.org to provide you with current  market-relevant content. Additionally  once you finish this course  you will be able to increase your knowledge with part two of this series: Mastering Advanced Scrum – A Scrum Master Training Course.A Scrum master is a Scrum team member responsible for fostering an effective and productive working environment and guiding others in understanding Scrum values  principles  and practices. Scrum masters are people-oriented  have high emotional intelligence  and enjoy assisting team members in growing. The material in this course shows you how to effectively guide your team in using Scrum and will consider why Scrum values are so important. Learn how to improve communication between the product owner  Scrum Team members  customers  stakeholders  and executives.This course is an excellent opportunity to improve your implementation skills  distinguish yourself in the global marketplace  and demonstrate advanced value to your employer or potential employer as a highly trained Agile professional. Since it is based on the most recent techniques and best practices  it would be a wise choice to enrol in this course now and start your journey to mastering Scrum today. Updated 15/12/22.

Personal development or life coaching is a highly in-demand profession in today’s world. Having a person who motivates others to reach their goals and realise their potential by working on their mental and physical self is often identified as a key ingredient for success. This course helps you explore what personal development involves and guides you in the best techniques for coaching and mentoring. It is a master class that provides you with the leading approaches and skills to become a sought-after life coach that helps people recognise their strengths  and overcome failures and unhappiness to live a better and enriched life.This course shows you how to help people break free from their limitations and live a more fulfilling life. Divided into different modules  the content covers various coaching  mentoring and management techniques to help your future clients gain control of their situations. The lessons provide the fundamental knowledge required to be a winning personal development coach  such as personal  management  time management  communication and organisational skills. You also become more aware of NLP (neuro-linguistic programming) and behavioural therapies and learn how to incorporate them into your coaching and mentoring methods for successful outcomes. By the end  you will be more confident to practise your trade as an effective life and personal development coach.This life course is a useful qualification to possess. A good start for students  graduates  job seekers or anyone interested in making a career in this industry  it is equally beneficial for those working in related fields as counsellors  HR managers  and team leaders who want to raise their skill sets or competencies. It will also help anyone in a leadership or management position aspiring to learn new techniques and discover new opportunities. Enrol now to help people grow and pave your move towards a lucrative coaching and mentoring career.

Dreams have always been a mystery to humans. Delighting  exciting  or sometimes even frightening  dreams have always drawn immense interest from every culture. In the past  dreams were believed to be a message for the future from the heavenly bodies. Interpreting them was based on myths and beliefs and was the role of psychics and soothsayers. In these modern and scientific times  dreams are viewed as an outcome of our mind's subconscious functions. product_name: Deprivation of Liberty Safeguards - DoLS Training
description: The Deprivation of Liberty Safeguards (DoLS) are an aspect of the Mental Capacity Act of 2005 enacted in the United Kingdom. They are designed to protect the most vulnerable members of society in hospitals and care homes and play a significant role in preventing the illegal detention or mistreatment of people who lack the mental capacity required to make their own decisions. This safeguarding and social work course provides the training required to begin your career as a DoLS assessor and also suits anyone who looks after an elderly or mentally incapacitated person.We begin by explaining what ‘deprivation of liberty’ means  when it should be used and how to avoid it. We then summarise the DoLS provisions and explore their background. The course then examines the Mental Capacity Act and lays out its five principles  code of practice and other related laws. We provide an in-depth understanding of the authorisation processes for deprivation of liberty and compare standard and urgent authorisation.Before the supervisory authority grants a DoLS request  it must undertake six critical evaluations. This section of the course describes these assessment measures and explains how to perform them. Finally  we explore the roles of different DoLS professionals  including the Approved Mental Health Professional  the Independent Mental Capacity Advocate  the Court of Protection  the Care Quality Commissions and others. The industry experts at Course Gate have developed this course to help you understand DoLS and advance your caregiving and social work career. Sign up today to learn how the UK’s Mental Capacity Act of 2005 protects the health  wellbeing and dignity of society’s most vulnerable people.

product_name: Maximizing Customer Engagement for Business Growth

We then explain how to calculate the customer lifetime value of a business. product_name: How to Stay Safe and Healthy During a Heat Wave
description: Enduring and surviving very uncomfortable heat waves may present a challenge as extreme temperatures can cause a variety of heat-related ailments and even death. product_name: FSSC 22000 - Fundamentals of Food Safety System
description: Food safety is one of the biggest humanitarian challenges our world faces today. product_name: EHS Guidelines - Environment  Health and Safety
description: Industries are essential for the economic stability and security of any country. product_name: Creative Thinking Skills in Early Childhood
description: Do you want your child to be a creative individual but don’t know how to cultivate such qualities from an early age? We then outline the key traits that are usually displayed by creative children as they develop.Are you wondering whether your child’s education will be a source of inspiration or a hindrance to their creative abilities? product_name: LSAT Prep: Everything You Need to Know
description: This course is designed to help aspiring law students perform well in the Law School Admission Test (LSAT) with their improved ability to employ critical and logical thinking skills. We explain how the LSAT ‘Logical Reasoning’ test evaluates your ability to analyse arguments. We then discuss conditional statements and explain how they differ from simple statements. You can confidently use these models and techniques to assist both preschoolers and school-age children. Epilepsy can begin at any age although it typically manifests in children or those older than 60. Recurrent  inexplicable convulsions are a prominent symptom of epilepsy. However  this ailment cannot be diagnosed after just one seizure. This epilepsy awareness course provides a foundational understanding of this neurological disorder. We begin by teaching you its classification  treatment issues and aetiology. This includes discussion of the causes of epilepsy  including head injuries  brain tumours and cerebrovascular disease.The course’s following section focuses on seizures. We review their classifications and delve into the specific acute management of seizures in people with intellectual disabilities. We also study the differential diagnosis of epilepsy  syncope  sleep disorders  migraines and so on. The course explains how to manage newly diagnosed epilepsy  chronic active epilepsy and epilepsy in different groups of ages. You show you how to identify the specific instances where antiepileptic medications should be used.Epilepsy is often accompanied by cognitive  psychological and behavioural changes. In this course’s final section  we explore the connection between epilepsy and behaviour and describe the associated risks of epilepsy  seizure control methods  safety aids and the phenomenon of ‘Sudden Unexpected Deaths in Epilepsy’ (SUDEP). Janets UK designed this course to raise awareness about epilepsy and provide the healthcare training you need to keep people safe. Sign up to learn how to protect epileptics from this famous but often misunderstood neurological disorder.

Language disorders in children are one of the most common causes of their difficulties with communication  social interaction and learning. Learning a language is generally a structured process but not all children develop all linguistic abilities in the same way or at the same pace. The ability to learn a language is considered an inherent human ability but children with a language disorder have difficulty understanding what they hear or read. They also face challenges when expressing themselves.This childhood development course examines different forms of child language disorders and describes the timeline for normal language development in children. We first identify the five components of language and the types of child language disorders. We then study the causes and symptoms of language disorders in children. We go through the structured process that drives normal language development from the prelinguistic period to the preschool and early school years. Similarly  we investigate specific language disorders such as pragmatic language disorder and morphosyntactic  phonological and semantic deficits.The following section examines different types of language impairment that can result from brain damage after birth. We cover subjects like acquired childhood aphasia  preschool language disorder  autism spectrum disorder and other acquired childhood language disorders. We then discuss the causes and effects of Down syndrome  Fragile X syndrome  Williams syndrome  learning disabilities and communication disorders. Finally  we present seven-step guidelines for helping children with language difficulties to achieve success in their academic studies. Sign up for this child psychology course to study how language disorders can disrupt childhood development and learn how to help them overcome such difficulties.

product_name: Introduction to Health and Safety in Caregiving
description: Caregivers must assume responsibility for their own safety and that of colleagues and those in their care. Caregivers and health and social care professionals must follow the guidelines contained in UK policies that aim to prevent accidents  illness  injuries and harm to anyone providing or receiving care. Carers require specialist training before they attempt certain workplace activities. This caregiving course provides an introduction to the training required by health and safety professionals.We begin with an exploration of the UK’s health and safety legislation  policies and prescribed procedures. We highlight the responsibilities of employers and carers in terms of health and safety. We then explain how to reduce the risk of accidents and illnesses by performing risk assessments for job hazards in order to deal with them. The course lays out the levels of first aid training  the elements of risk assessment and the role of stress management in caregiving environments  which could also include the home.The course then goes through the guidelines for fire safety enforcement. We examine other hazards and delve into stress management. We identify work-related stress triggers and highlight the signs of stress. Our last sections review the UK's legislation pertaining to ‘moving and handling’ risks in health and social care settings. We establish the significance of the ‘Lifting Operations and Lifting Equipment Regulations’ (LOLER) and ‘Reporting of Injuries  Diseases and Dangerous Occurrence Regulations’ (RIDDOR) for health and safety management in the workplace. This caregiving training course provides the skills you need to manage and control risks effectively and.comply with the UK’s statutory laws and legal norms governing occupational health and safety.

product_name: Information and Communication Handling in Caregiving
description: Active communication and interpersonal skills play a crucial role in healthcare and social care. Medical practitioners  social workers and caregivers need to be able to send and share information efficiently to help them develop strong working relationships and ensure that important data is transmitted accurately and privately. Communication experts stress that the needs of the patient are always the most crucial aspect of healthcare and social care and that effective communication is key to good patient care. Care professionals should thus be able to identify constructive ways to communicate with people on an individual basis.This caregiving course explains how to handle information and communication and examines the UK regulations governing the secure sharing of patient data. We examine verbal and nonverbal communication techniques that you can use to establish constructive professional connections with your clients. We highlight the importance and contributions of sign language and technological aids in nonverbal communication. You will also learn to use clues from ‘objects of reference’ to engage with patients and encourage interaction with service users.Effective communication depends on certain elements and we investigate the driving forces behind body language and the triggers for reaction scenarios. We provide strategies that can help you to overcome communication barriers in the work environment. The course also explains how to ensure the secure handling of information and examines systems used to store data. We go through the Caldicott principles of data confidentiality and lay out the eight principles of data protection employed in the UK. Sign up to improve your communication and information management skills as a care professional and learn how to protect your client’s dignity and advance your caregiving career.

Workplace conflicts cost organisations a lot of money. According to some research  employees in the United States spent about 2.8 hours per week dealing with professional disputes. Some disagreements can lead to both organisational and personal losses. This conflict resolution course lays out the various disadvantages of conflict  the major causes of workplace disputes and the managerial processes used to resolve them.We first describe the various forms of conflict and identify the fundamental purpose of conflict resolution and its role in business development. The course then breaks down each of the six steps of conflict resolution. Conflict does not always bring about negative results and can sometimes improve organisations. We discuss both the positive and negative potential outcomes of such disputes. This part of the course focuses on the role of human behavioural styles and emphasises the importance of emotional intelligence in dealing with conflict.The course guides you through the steps taken to understand a problem and provides techniques you can employ to find solutions to them. We go over several insider tips and expert techniques used to establish a friendly and approachable work environment that encourages cooperation. Finally  the course explains the significance of effective communication and ethical conduct in the workplace. This course is suitable for managers and human resource professionals who deal with groups of people every day. Sign up to learn how to build a better work environment and add an important new skill to your management toolbox.

product_name: Permanent Makeup for the Lips  Eyes and Brows
description: Most people want to look and feel their best and cosmetics offer one way to do so. More and more consumers are following the trend of using permanent cosmetics. This makeup tutorial provides the skills required to apply permanent makeup professionally  either on yourself and your friends or for clients as part of a beauty salon. This cosmetics course is taught by Kristina Bagrova  a certified award-winning beautician.We first explain the procedures and methods used to apply permanent makeup to the brows. Our video demonstrations show you how to prepare the face before treatments and describe the various instruments you will use to perform them. We establish the importance of hygiene in the beauty industry and explain how to disinfect the tools used to apply makeup. We then lay out each step of the procedure used to apply multiple passes and touch up powdered eyebrows.Many people struggle to apply flawless permanent eyeliner so we go through the procedure carefully to provide you with this valuable cosmetic skill. The course then explains how to provide other popular services  including lip pigmentation and its outlining  contouring and filling in. We then provide a demonstration of the techniques used to apply permanent makeup to the eyes  brows and lips on a latex model to help you add this skill to your repertoire. This course is ideal for anyone who wishes to become a professional permanent makeup artist and also suits anyone curious about these increasingly popular cosmetic procedures. Sign up for this permanent makeup tutorial to make better beauty decisions for yourself or your clients.

Increased globalisation and advancing technologies are bringing diverse cultural perspectives and lifestyles closer to our homes and workplaces. This brings many advantages and new perspectives but cross-cultural interactions also present challenges  including misunderstandings and poor communication. An enhanced appreciation of cross-cultural awareness can help us to overcome these barriers. With that in mind  the experts at Janets UK have designed this course on cross-cultural communication to help you enhance productivity in the workplace while making it a space that respects diversity  equity and inclusion (DEI).The course begins with an examination of the fundamental concepts of cross-cultural awareness and the factors that impact diverse settings. We then explore the perceptions and various cultural values that affect the relationships among people from different backgrounds. We explain how to interpret and respond to cultural differences in ways that build healthy relationships through appropriate responses that accommodate diverse viewpoints. The course shows you how improved listening skills can help you to overcome cultural barriers to communication.We then explore the concept of ‘cross-cultural design’  which refers to the strategies used to design technology for people from many cultures. We examine the communication platforms required for cross-cultural communication and introduce you to leadership management principles that enhance cohesion and productivity in multicultural teams. The course outlines the procedures used to recruit culturally diverse teams and manage them effectively. Respect for cross-cultural values has become a valued trait for today’s managers and DEI competence adds an important element to your human resources management skills. Sign up for this DEI training to learn how to communicate  lead and manage people from diverse cultural backgrounds.

Food can be the deadliest poison or the most effective medicine. In keeping food safe to earth  it is crucial that we study the microorganisms that live in  produce or contaminate food since good health begins on the inside and at the microbiological level. This course explores  the principles of microbial ecology  psychiatry  metabolism and genetics. We highlight ancient and modern food preservation techniques that can reduce spoilage and make food more attractive and even taste better.The course then discusses the functions of microorganisms in food. We show you how to improve the microbiological quality of food through effective food processing techniques that ward off microbes. We explain how microbial growth affects the microbiological standards and specifications for nutrition and food items. Using microorganisms for food preservation extends the shelf life of food products while maintaining their quality and safety. With this in mind  we demonstrate several food preservation techniques and their importance to food security.Finally  the course studies foodborne diseases caused by contamination via microorganisms and microbial toxins. We go through the factors that affect the susceptibility of food to microbial attacks and lay out the classification of foodborne diseases. Lastly  we discuss career opportunities available to microbiologists in the food industry and highlight their responsibilities and challenges. This course examines the science of food microbiology to provide practical food protection skills you can use to keep food safe and delicious.

product_name: Learn English: Prefixes and Suffixes with Reporting Verbs
description: This course provides grammar skills and helpful vocabulary to enhance your command of the English language. It begins with an overview of different types of prefixes and suffixes and demonstrates how they transform the meaning of single words. We then present you with articles  videos  and audio clips to help you practice your growing English abilities.The course then explores indirect speech. We first review the previously covered forms of indirect speech in the present and past tenses and questions. We then explain how to use indirect questions in the perfect continuous form. We illustrate using reporting verbs in indirect speech to form various formulas  passive sentences  and exclamations.We have designed this course to help you to improve your English reading  speaking  and writing skills. Adding common English prefixes and suffixes to root words will boost your confidence and communication ability. There are exercises found in our ‘Resources’ section that you can download to try out your newfound knowledge and skills immediately. Language proficiency can open personal and professional doors for you  so sign up for these English lessons to master prefixes  suffixes  and indirect speech.

The forest school education model has a developmental ethos shared by thousands of trained practitioners across the world. Such teachers continually refine their learning styles and skills to serve children and help them develop. This teacher training course explores the innovative forest school approach to education that provides learning experiences in woodlands or other tree-filled natural settings. We first lay out the teaching philosophy’s history and guiding principles before describing its advantages and impact on children’s academic  social  psychological and practical competence. We then discuss the central policies and procedures related to setting up and running a forest school programme while describing the associated risks.The course then examines the various forest school learning activities like nature watching  ‘reading’ clouds  treasure hunting and dye making. We trace their impact on a child's development and discuss benefits like stress reduction  mood improvement and increased concentration. We show you how other important playful activities like splashing  memory games  crafting and tree climbing can be conducted in forest school programmes. The course also demonstrates the value of various survival activities such as building shelters  foraging and making fires.The course then looks at how forest schools support a child's psychological  physical  social and cognitive development. We explain how forest school sessions can help children to improve several abilities  including their communication  problem-solving  risk-taking and emotional intelligence. We then establish the significance of eco-friendly forest schooling and discuss how to maintain eco-friendly practices by camping in a designated area and using fire pits and non-toxic products and while wildlife with care. Finally  we cover the key aspects of health and safety relevant to education and lay out the risk assessment procedure  risk-benefit analyses and the role of forest school leaders in identifying and mitigating the main physical and environmental dangers specific to wooded areas. Forest schooling offers the young a stimulating and innovative educational alternative and can play a constructive role in driving childhood development. Sign up to add this cutting-edge pedagogic skill to your teaching portfolio.

product_name: Training on Infection Prevention and Control Principles
description: This course explores modern infection prevention and control methods. It starts with an introduction to infection and infection control and lays out the different stages of infection spreading  often called the ‘chain of infection’. The prevention and control of infection in the workplace involves everyone. We describe the specific roles and responsibilities of the health department  employers and employees concerning the spread of disease.We then discuss the microbiology involved in the cycle of infection and the different means of transmission. We study decontamination methods and standards used to classify products according to the level of danger associated with their use. The course then examines the relevant regulations  infection control policies and prescribed procedures and their implementation according to published guidelines. We also establish the necessity of infection risk assessment and management.The next section emphasises the importance of personal protective equipment (PPE). We explain the impact of hazard assessments and discuss PPE legislation  the duties of employees regarding PPE and the requirement for PPE. We also describe the different types of such equipment and their practical uses in detail. The course’s final section focuses on person-to-person spread of infection. Sign up for this epidemiology course to learn about the external and internal variables that drive infection control practice  the chain of transmission and techniques to prevent and control infection.

product_name: How to Conduct Research in Adult Care
description: Do you know how to conduct good research? This research methodology course takes you through each step of the research process  from writing up a proposal to analysing and publishing your results. We compare qualitative and quantitative research and examine some typical objectives before exploring the history of health research. We lay out the effects of research on personal development and cost-effective healthcare interventions. We delve into pure and applied research and compare various research methods like the mixed methods  deductive and inductive approaches.The course provides examples of methodologies used in the healthcare sector  such as case the note review and cohort observation models. We take you through the steps of using evidence-based and data analysis processes. We show you how to choose an appropriate research topic and write a clear justification for your decision. The course discusses the principles that adult care settings must follow and lays out their role in your research design. Vulnerable adults require specific standards of care in order to protect their wellbeing and dignity and this course explains how to include such concerns in your research. We study the various types of data and the methods used for data analysis in qualitative research.Finally  we explain how to present research data with guides to data visualisation and graphic presentation of your findings. We show you how to write research reports and make conclusions and recommendations. This course is suitable for anyone seeking to master research methods and apply them in adult care settings. It has no prerequisites and is aimed at adult care and healthcare students and professionals who need to know how to protect their vulnerable subjects while conducting valuable scientific research.

The advent of the internet has established the field of digital journalism  which has changed the way news is created and reported across online networks to quickly share breaking news that features graphics and audio in the form of multimedia. This type of reporting has become more important and today's news environment requires media-specific journalistic abilities. Journalistic styles and structures from print  radio and television get copied  modified and adjusted for the different demands created by the medium of the internet. This digital journalism course explains how new media supplanted conventional forms and describes the abilities  mobile reporting tools and apps that modern journalists require. We first examine the architecture of the internet  including its web browsers  the file transfer protocol  terminologies  narrative forms and services.Digital journalism allows connected debates on public news items. This course shows you how blogs can demonstrate the journalist's personality and abilities and how photos alone may tell a story. We cover technical aspects of the job like hypertext  link structure  voice control navigation  usability  the user experience and website design. We explain how to create narratives using video  infographics and other visual components that create a sense of immediacy. The course also explores multimedia  the four phases of news  the merits and drawbacks of various media  the news-gathering approach  video content and communication technologies.This journalism course teaches you how to conduct user research  create online publishing  leverage online networks and monetise the web. Our lessons cover data journalism  metrics  analytics  artificial intelligence and virtual reality. Due to the rising levels of cyberbullying and harassment experienced by female and freelance journalists in the UK  the course contains an entire section on protecting oneself from such threats and trolls. Finally  we explore the ethics of digital journalism and provide the legal knowledge you need to evaluate whether your stories are relevant  appropriate and in the public interest. We describe the reporting restrictions pertinent to court processes and examine election laws  the Defamation Act  copyright laws and the internet safety requirements governing journalists. This course teaches all aspects of digital journalism from the ground up and provides all the training you need to set up and run a professional news site. Sign up to learn how to connect with a wider audience and turn your journalistic skills into an extra revenue stream in the form of self-publishing on new media.

Automated external defibrillators (AEDs) are devices that restore a healthy heartbeat by shocking or pulsing the heart with electricity. This course introduces you to various types of AEDs and demonstrates how to use them to improve the odds of survival in cases of cardiac arrest. The National Health Service (NHS) in the United Kingdom operates a procurement and logistics service called the ‘NHS Supply Chain’. This organisation provides a variety of goods and services  including AEDs  to NHS sites like hospitals  clinics and healthcare facilities. We go through the process of purchasing an AED through the NHS Supply Chain and describe the proper installation of the device at a suitable location. We explain how to perform defibrillation  which can save lives during a cardiac arrest  and how to perform cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) to increase its effectiveness.It is important to follow proper safety precautions when using an AED to ensure that the device is used effectively and that the safety of the patient  paramedics and bystanders is not compromised. We lay out the necessary safety measures to take when using an AED in various situations. We also identify the objects and substances that must be removed prior to using the AED to protect the patient's safety. The goal of installing an AED in the workplace is to protect both employees and the general public. This course describes the advantages of placing AEDs in workplaces and educational institutions and explores the UK government's recommendations concerning the practice. Regular maintenance of AEDs is important because it ensures that the device will be in good working order and ready to use in an emergency. We show you how to maintain an AED and discuss when to replace it and the medical protocols to follow to ensure safe usage.This course has been developed for health and safety officers and aspiring paramedics but also suits anyone who provides first-aid in the UK. They must meet updated AED training requirements from the Health and Safety Executive (HSE). This course has no prerequisites and enhances your CV by teaching you valuable skills and knowledge about CPR and AEDs. We present appropriate illustrations and diagrams to clarify the course material and help you acquire practical skills. Learning how to operate an AED is important for everyone because it can save the lives of people around you and this course can open doors for you as an AED operator in various organisations and settings. Sign up to pick up valuable first aid and emergency response skills that can save lives.

product_name: Diary Management: Guide to Effectively Managing Your Time
description: Everyone  especially small business owners  can benefit from keeping an accurate diary that records all of their meetings  deadlines  travel plans and appointments. However  poor diary management can result in missed appointments  inefficiency  low work quality  stress  a poor reputation  difficulty in coordination and communication  social problems  potential financial loss and legal issues. Diary and office managers are expected to create records and document events neatly and simply. Do you want to learn how to effectively manage your diary like a pro and stay on top of your schedule? In this time management course  we teach you how to organise a dairy properly  take and organise notes  schedule meetings  optimise your time and keep track of tasks. We then show you how to use some note-taking programs  diary management tools and more. We start by discussing what diary management entails and identifying the diary management responsibilities of a personal assistant or office manager.The course compares the two types of diary management and emphasises the importance of both to organisational efficiency. We highlight the kind of activities that can and should be diarised. We provide some effective diary practices and tactics such as setting reminders  responding to appointments and more. Taking meeting notes is an important aspect of diary management and involves recording important information discussed during a meeting. We explain how to properly take notes and minutes and go through four note-taking methods. The course establishes the importance of scheduling and provides organisational techniques to help you stay on schedule and on time. Keeping track of ongoing tasks involves monitoring and maintaining a list of activities that need to be completed  along with their deadlines and priorities. We go through various techniques designed to do this effectively so that you make the most of the day and boost productivity.This time management course teaches you how to use a planner effectively to get the most out of it. In addition to useful organisational software  we also explore some dairy management tricks and tips used to optimise schedules. A properly maintained diary will serve as a reliable resource for keeping records  scheduling new appointments and determining your availability. Time is our most essential commodity and must be managed properly. This course is designed for everyone but most suits small business owners and personal assistants that frequently have to juggle a seemingly insurmountable number of responsibilities. Sign up to learn how to manage your time effectively  bring order to chaos and squeeze the most out of each day.

The Earth has sustained life for billions of years. Would you like to know how it all works? This course published by Course Gate lays out the basic concepts of ecology. We trace the relationships between organisms and their physical environment. Our first module explores the ideas of the natural order of living things and evolution. We discuss the role of bacteria  fungi and other microorganisms that have only been studied since the invention of the microscope.  The course defines the term ‘ecosystem’  which are crucial for ecological activities like the maintenance of life support systems and regulation of energy flow. We then examine natural resources  the ‘pecking order’ and the role of competition within evolutionary niches. We then study how organisms adapt to environmental changes and identify the adverse effects caused by human activities. We discuss the difficulties caused by pollution  including acid rain  global warming  the depletion of natural resources and other artificial challenges. We address the global concern of climate change. Climate is a major factor in the physical environment and ultimately determines water availability and thermal conditions. This section focuses on climate space  adaptation and the effects of climate change. Finally  we explore environmental conservation  which is crucial in terms of preserving drinking water and the ozone layer and sustaining human and animal food chains via the prudent use of non-renewable resources. Sign up to learn how the natural world is arranged into ecosystems and what role you can play in preserving it.

Display screen equipment (DSE) like computer monitors play a key role in many businesses. However  if not managed properly  screens can be hazardous to employees' health in the workplace. In the United Kingdom  DSE training is a legal requirement for anyone who regularly uses these devices. This course is designed to help DSE users comply with the Health and Safety (DSE) Regulations of 1992 and to help them understand how to set up their workstations ergonomically to minimise the chances of developing musculoskeletal disorders.We start by introducing you to the training methods employed by DSE users. We lay out the DSE assessment processes and examine the UK’s Health and Safety (DSE) Regulations. We study the responsibilities of employers and employees in maintaining the safe use of screens. We then go through some health issues associated with screens  such as musculoskeletal disorders  eye strains  back pain and mental stress. We discuss the symptoms  causes and treatment options of such ailments. The course then demonstrates the benefits of good posture and shows you how to protect your back when working at a desk for long periods.This health and safety course then compares different types of workstations and explains how to optimise them for comfort  productivity and health. Finally  we study factors to consider when choosing portable devices like laptops  tablets and smartphones. This course is published by Course Gate  a company that specialises in providing online learning opportunities  and is taught by industry experts. Sign up for this health and safety course to meet the legal compliance requirements associated with DSEs and protect your eyes and back from the effects of long use of screens.

Providing excellent healthcare requires medical skills that include a proper understanding of equality  diversity and inclusion. This course is designed by Alpha Academy to help medical personnel and caregivers of any skill level. All care workers must be able to identify incidents involving discrimination and promote the principles of equality and diversity as they perform their roles. We will examine the UK’s legislation and policies established to support these principles and ensure the dignity of those in your care.The course then explores the person-centred approach applied to planning for individual and social care settings. It is typically an effective way to place the service user at the centre of care planning stages and empower them to significantly influence the care and support they receive. We explain how to support the lifestyle of care receivers and review the different activities that promote their wellbeing.We then show you how to preserve the mental health and self-esteem of clients  which is an essential element of a caregiver’s role. Finally  our last lesson explains how to deal with complex and sensitive situations and manage risk. This social work and healthcare course helps you to develop empathy  sensitivity and a good sense of fairness in your dealings with clients and patients. Sign up to learn how to respect DEI values and protect the dignity and wellbeing of those in your care.

product_name: Junior Certificate Project Maths - Ordinary Level
description: Your Junior Cert Ordinary Level maths assessment is just around the corner; what topic should you be focusing on in preparation? Or would you benefit from looking over multiple maths properties that you haven't touched on in a while? No matter the answer  this course has what you need to succeed in your mathematical problems. Algebra  Trigonometry  and Shapes are just some areas covered!You will start with lessons teaching you about statistics and the probability of events; while also discussing the relationships between the sides and angles of the objects with geometry and trigonometry. Number formats such as decimals  scientific notation  and how to work with negative  positive  and fractional indices are also introduced. Topics from algebra and calculus  such as expanding brackets and factorising  will help to wrap up this course.From finding the area of various shapes to working with functions this course has what you need to succeed. Whether you are studying for the Irish Junior Certificate or looking to gain a good understanding of fundamental mathematical skills and knowledge this course will be of great interest to you. So why wait? Start this course today!

product_name: Junior Certificate Project Maths - Higher Level
description: How strong are your maths skills? Do you feel that you could benefit from reviewing high-level maths content? This course is for students interested in studying the Project Maths Junior Certificate Higher Level course and provides students with tutorial videos. It starts off teaching you about probability and statistics where you will learn about constructing a stem and leaf diagram  arrangements and selections  and the probability of events.In the next module  you will learn about the shape  size  relative position and properties of space of objects with geometry  and about the relationships between the sides and angles of the objects with trigonometry. In the third module  you will learn about number formats such as decimal  scientific notation  and how to work with indices (negative  positive and fractional).Next  you will be taught algebra  starting with simple formulae  expanding brackets and factorising. The second part of algebra will teach you about solving different types of equations. This course would be of great interest to anyone studying for the Irish Junior Certificate  or anyone looking to gain a good understanding of fundamental high school maths skills and knowledge.

product_name: Leaving Certificate Project Maths - Ordinary Level
description: This course is for students interested in studying the Project Maths Ordinary Level Course for the Irish Leaving Certificate or just furthering their knowledge and skill in Mathematics. This course provides students with videos on all the Ordinary Level topics in one location listed by module and topic.The course starts off with teaching the learner about calculating probability and working out the statistics of different math problems/questions. Then it goes into the shape  size  length of sides  angles and relative position of figures/objects with geometry and trigonometry. Along with teaching the learner about arithmetic or financial maths  so you can workout your PRSI  net profit  take home pay and more. The first section then finishes off by teaching you about calculating the length  area and volume of different objects.The second section starts off with introducing you to algebra and what it is  teaching you about processes need to work out algebraic equations. Next you will learn about solving various different types of algebraic equations working with inequalities. After which you will learn about manipulating complex numbers  the meaning of i and imaginary numbers. In the functions module you will learn about how to solve functions and plot them on graphs. The last module will teach you about working out the differentiation  and the second derivative  along with rules and important formulas for calculus.

product_name: Leaving Certificate Project Maths - Higher Level
description: Project Maths is part of the Irish curriculum  but this course can be taken by anyone who wants to improve their understanding of high school mathematics. It provides students with videos on all the Higher Level maths topics as well as a comprehensive assessment that tests learners on the entire content of the Project Maths Higher Level syllabus. Modules cover probability and statistics  geometry and trigonometry  numbers and shapes  algebra  functions and calculus.This course will help you to solve mathematical probability problems and statistical equations. You will learn how to use trigonometry to find the area  sides and angles of shapes  and work with different number systems and series. Next  you will be taught to calculate percentages  profit and interest  including VAT (value-added tax) and APR (annual percentage rate). Move onto solving for the length  area and volume of 2D and 3D shapes before learning to solve quadratic equations and equations with indices  including simultaneous equations. Finally  get to grips with functions and fractions.Because this course is self-paced and charges no sign-up or subscription fees  you can move through the material as quickly or slowly as you like  taking your time with any parts of maths you struggle with. By the end  you will have a thorough grounding in the key parts of the Project Maths syllabus.

product_name: Strand 1 Leaving Certificate Ordinary Level Probability and Statistics
description: Statistics can be very useful for making sense of the information around us and how it might affect us.
